name: Anthony D'Esposito
subject: Remembering September 11th: Honoring Lives Lost and Reaffirming Our Resolve
body:
Peter, Today marks a solemn anniversary, the day we remember the tragic events of September 11, 2001.
Today marks a solemn anniversary, the day we remember the tragic events of September 11, 2001. This day is etched in the collective memory of our nation. We mourn the lives lost and honor the bravery shown by first responders.It's a day for unity, reminding us of what we stand for as a country. We must remain vigilant to protect our freedoms and the American way of life.I encourage you to participate in local remembrance events and support the charities that benefit the 9/11 families and survivors. We renew our commitment to the principles that make our country great.God Bless America.Best regards, Rep. name: Will Hurd
subject: Never Forget
body:
Dive into controversial remarks and how Gen Z connects with 9/11.
---
| | | | | |
---
| _Welcome to The Brief! Common sense takes on current events, national security, and technology and the latest campaign info. It’s designed to make you smarter in less than 5 minutes! If you were forwarded this message, you can get_[ _The Brief here_](https://75y20.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SwqjWE9AVSrhUQO3Hke6ErDEjay4/l5Z1-shiKGQz) _._
---
| Dear Friends, Today marks the 22nd anniversary of September 11, 2001. For 22 years, this day has made me actually think of September 12 – the day we woke up bloodied and bruised but united in the determination that America and our principles of freedom and liberty would live to see another day. Unfortunately, we have people that question the events of September 11. Many of our fellow Americans don't share the visceral feelings from that day because they weren't alive or too young. But there are still many Americans showing in their unique ways why we should never forget. Here are three thoughts to ponder on this day.
---
| | [](https://75y20.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SwqjWE9AVvCPgqmPNfoMIgb3iKg8/dAlrppszOBIY)
---
---
| | | | |
### 1\. CONSPIRACY THEORIES IMPACT REALITY
---

| | | | |
---
| Photo by DALL-E **Big Picture:** A popular candidate for President, Vivek Ramaswamy, has been embroiled in scandal because he implied that 9/11 was an "inside job." Conspiracy theories about 9/11 started immediately after the events on that fateful day.
* Extensive reports by the 9/11 Commission, US government agencies and expert groups found failures in our intelligence, missed signals, and a need for change but they all refuted the existence of any hidden conspiracy.

**Why This Matters:** Conspiracy theories hurt the survivors. They hurt the heroes. They hurt America. Hoax theories undermine trust in our institutions. They disrespect memories when families are still grieving and heroes bear scars.
* People who ignore real evidence and real tragedies should be ashamed. Instead of pushing conspiracies to gain attention and clicks, we owe respect to every soul lost and every hero risen. Truth matters. 9/11 was real and we should never forget.

**Bottom-line:** Today is a day to remember the nearly 3,000 lives lost. Today is a day to honor the bravery of first responders. Today is a day to recommit to remaining vigilant against future threats. Today is a day to thank those who prevented another attack from happening again.
* To get a perspective on what we can learn from how Americans felt after the tragedy, read a blog I wrote last year about [leadership and 9/11](https://75y20.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SwqjWE9AWNX7tHAlTaycMVysh4OC/_ZEsVop9XUx8).

---

| | | | |
### 2\. **LIFE DEFINING MOMENT OR DRY HISTORY LESSON?**
---

|
---
| Photo: Military recruits practice taking the oath of enlistment at Fort George G. Meade on July 05, 2023 in Fort Meade, Maryland. _Anna Moneymaker/Getty Images_ **Big Picture:** According to an [NPR report](https://75y20.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SwqjWE9AWprq5hZ7ZW8sQLMhfo6G/dJKnwtPMt4JO), most new recruits joining the active-duty military service were either very young or not yet born during the 9/11 attacks in 2001. According to the 2019 U.S. Census Bureau, 31.7 percent of the U.S. population is between ages 0-24, which makes up Generation Z.
* A defining trait of Gen Z is that most of them were too young to recall or even live through the events of 9-11.

**Why This Matters:** For most adults, September 11, 2001 is a day that they will remember forever. But if you are in middle school or high school, Sept. 11 might mean nothing more to you than a history lesson.
* This shift could have implications for how the military educates its members about historical events and their significance, as well as how it ensures readiness and preparedness for future challenges.

**Bottom-Line** : The U.S. military is entering a new era where many of its newest members don't have a personal connection to one of the nation's most defining moments and the most senior members' experiences are almost exclusively defined by it.
* This evolution necessitates a reevaluation of how the military remains adaptive to preventing threats we know about and prepared for the challenges that we don't.

---

|
### 3\. A 21-MILE SALUTE
---
|
---
| **Big Picture** : This September 11th I was in Iowa joining the "March to the Capitol - Des Moines" -- an annual 9/11 memorial walk organized to commemorate the victims and heroes of the September 11, 2001 attacks.
* The event is a 21-mile walk, symbolizing a walking 21-gun salute, starting from Waukee and ending at the State Capitol.

**Why This Matters** : This march serves as a poignant reminder of the tragic events of 9/11, ensuring that the memories of those who lost their lives are honored. The event emphasizes unity and remembrance.**Bottom-Line** : Events like "March to the Capitol" are more than just a memorial walk; it's a testament to the enduring spirit of unity, remembrance, and respect for the heroes and victims of 9/11. Participating in events that foster community involvement ensures we never forget.
---

Thank you! God bless America and don’t forget to [donate today!](https://75y20.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SwqjWE9AXICYI7xTfRJ8UAkWeXoK/gHs9KCZTkfd_) Will Hurd

subject: South Dakota & Trump, Constitutional Carry & More!
body:

| **South Dakota was... monumental!**
---
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| _Photos. Top L-R: Rejeana Jackson (Klamath County GOP Chair), President Trump, my daughter Vivien, me and Solomon Yue (Oregon’s National Committeeman to the RNC) last week. Center photos: Governor Kristi Noem and South Dakota GOP Chair John Wiik. Bottom row photos: 7,000 people in that arena and South Dakota Lt. Governor Larry Rhoden._

Last week was bittersweet. During Oregon's COVID lockdown debacle, I was the first elected official in our state to use my "legislative" authority as Mayor of Baker City to tell then-Governor Kate Brown to pound sand. I had amazing councilors like Joanna Dixon and Johnny Waggoner fighting by my side. But when the rest of the state stayed silent, I took Vivien on a road trip to South Dakota and seriously considered moving there. Right after we returned, Baker City's Resolution hit the national news, other cities and counties at last joined in, and I decided to stay in Oregon and fight. Though my own run for governor didn't end as we'd hoped, I still think our state needs some of the policies I've watched Governor Noem enact. South Dakota feels as free, conservative and sane as I remember; it feels like Oregon felt when I was a child. Oregonians are stuck grieving for the Oregon we wish we still had. South Dakota gives me hope.

My thanks go out to South Dakota GOP Chair John Wiik, Governor Kristi Noem, President Trump and the staff of the Trump campaign who pulled off this amazing Monumental Leaders event and made Vivien's belated birthday gift an epic one! She has always been a huge Trump fan, and as Solomon tells her, in decades to come the enormity of that photo will hit her. President Trump told her that above all, he's doing what he's doing for her. I get it. If we don't stand and fight, we won't have a Republic to pass down to our children.

We are STILL working on that Oregon Trump rally, folks. President Trump told me to not stop trying. He's still willing, but I've had to take a new, creative step toward making the logistics work out. Pray. A lot. That's all I can say for now, but I'll keep you posted.

Finally, if you see that security officer in the arena photo (in tan by the rail) at RAP where he works, tell him you saw him in this newsletter! We ran into him on the way out, and also flew in with one of the Secret Service agents who stood by the stage behind #47. We've definitely had some great adventures this past week!
---

---

---
---
We're collecting signatures like crazy, but ...

* ... if you can't get to a signing location or event, just download the single-signer sheet at [**www.ConstitutionalCarryforOregon.com**](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/H3YrmIP4BYUqLlffGMnNTg~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRm4kZkP0UgNWNmNzY0ZDUxODA0ZDgxNDBiNjgxNjE2OTgxMmUxM2FEK2h0dHA6Ly93d3cuQ29uc3RpdHV0aW9uYWxDYXJyeWZvck9yZWdvbi5jb21XBXNwY2V1Qgpk9WTB_2TX3tfpUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAABfYw~~), print, sign, and mail it in!

* Have you used your Oregon tax credit yet? This is a CREDIT not a deduction. $50 per person donated to Constitutional Carry for Oregon will be immediately credited on your tax return just by checking a box on your tax return. If you don't donate, the State will take your money and use it toward all the things you don't want! **Please consider donating to our cause today. Bottom line: we need your donations to help get the word out!**

**Kids Patriot Camp!**
---
I'm proud to serve as First Vice President for a group of effective, conservative NE Oregon Republicans: The Baker County Republican Women! Robyn has been hard at work building a wonderful new website for us, and we've begun raising funds for our future patriot camp. Why? Because Oregon's schools have become subpar at best and an indoctrination system at worst. We need to step into the gap and teach our children real U.S. history and about our Constitution.

subject: How dare they?
body:
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...

Dear Friend,
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...
...but my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, is the next big target of the radical anti-police movement and I urgently need your help before they make an example out of him.
That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo.
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0550j81joh8frklloipcstl8evgrn2lu1ch80r0_rp22sh2s8i66p71cli64o71chh2bs)
Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.
He's dedicated his life to protecting others. But we live in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage, LIED about what happened, and trashed Mark's reputation.
And now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. [**That 's why I wrote this letter to you, someone I've never met before, to ask for your help.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z87n7mbus44ocj1oev9p575c4miduunpmb1a6lbg_rp22sh2s8i66p71cli64o71chh2bs)
But first, let me explain what happened...
On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a _violent_ _criminal_ named Quadren Wilson.
Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for allegedly dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom.
Mark's arrest team planned to capture Wilson in his vehicle using a containment strategy. They pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But Wilson floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape justice.
Mark and another officer exited their vehicle to make the arrest. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But Wilson refused Mark's commands to show his hands, continuing to spin his wheels and try to force his way out.
With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw Wilson reach into the center console and pull his hand up.
Mark thought Wilson had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire. Then Mark felt something hit the shield he was holding and push him backward.** **
**Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle.**
Mark believed his life and his fellow officers' lives were in danger. He did what he was trained to do and stopped the threat.
Thankfully, Wilson survived and no one else was injured. But because Wilson is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target Mark.
Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that Wilson "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster.
And on September 22, 2022, the liberal District Attorney caved to the mob and filed BOGUS felony charges against Mark. **Now Mark faces 10 YEARS in prison.**
[**_Now I hope you can see why I 'm turning to you for help today._**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zb6hubvj54ahkk17mahhuqa1m8cb5j5euj3a45uo_rp22sh2s8i66p71cli64o71chh2bs)
Mark dedicated his life to helping others. He's spent 30 years in law enforcement, most of them with the Milwaukee Police Department (MPD).
We knew fighting alone against the anti-police movement here in Wisconsin would be impossible and our hope that justice would prevail was quickly fading when we received a call from **the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF)** offering to help Mark.
This incredible organization helps innocent officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.
Law and justice experts like President Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Edwin Meese and former FBI Assistant Director Ronald Hosko serve on LELDF's Board. LELDF's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.
In short, these are experts when it comes to policing. And they thoroughly vet cases to determine if an officer was wrongly accused or charged before deciding to help.
They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses, whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court. And they do it all free of charge!
But LELDF doesn't receive any money from the government to help police officers facing unjust charges. They're funded entirely by the generous support of folks like you who can recognize a miscarriage of justice and want to help fix it.
This is why I reached out to you today. I needed to ask you a very important question:
[**_Will you please help my husband Mark fight the unjust charges against him and clear his name by rushing a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF today?_**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zha7nbf1sau6c2k42v1comhrsvmqjg793n5qrqlo_rp22sh2s8i66p71cli64o71chh2bs)
Your kind gift today of $35, $50, or $100 to help Mark will mean so much to my family.
Or, if you're blessed with the means to help with a gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more, I pray you will so my husband doesn't spend 10 YEARS behind bars away from his family.
Right now, LELDF is preparing to ramp up legal action in Mark's case. [**So please follow this link to make your tax-deductible donation right away.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zen00jf08f3givnf3dnkunl47jsij0fqtn6pvbm0_rp22sh2s8i66p71cli64o71chh2bs)
Any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. No matter what you're able to give, please say a prayer for Mark and our family.
Thank you in advance for your generous support of my family and LELDF.
With deepest gratitude,
Becky Wagner
P.S. Mark is the type of person who'd offer to donate a kidney to a friend in need just because it's the right thing to do. In fact, that's exactly what he did when he donated one of his kidneys to his former partner of more than a decade! Mark didn't even let his partner know he got checked out as a potential donor. He just said that his partner had young kids who needed him to be around and it was the right thing to do.
This is the type of man the anti-police mob is targeting and trying to destroy: a kidney donor, a youth football coach, a man who assists the elderly from our parish in running errands and doing handy-man projects. A man of faith who's always helping others.
Mark faces 10 years behind bars - simply for doing his job to serve and protect. [**_Will you help him clear his name by making a tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today?_** ](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zu7behnuqav27u8q4426midstosa26g17mrtsrjg_rp22sh2s8i66p71cli64o71chh2bs) Your generosity will help LELDF mount the strongest legal defenses for my husband and other wrongly accused officers. Thank you in advance for your prayers and support.

\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.leldf.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_

Meet Ron DeSantis

A native Floridian with
blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a
nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin
High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he
was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated
with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission
in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service,
Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah,
Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military
decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service
and the Iraq Campaign Medal.

Ron
also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child
predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a
platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits
and a balanced budget amendment.

In
Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the
weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to
hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in
manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a
veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our
country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans
and expand support for mental health.

In
2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As
governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for
the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when
the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media
united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis
stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding
principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to
transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival.
Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative
priorities:

Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine
mandates,

Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border
crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against
illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured
professors accountable,

Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital
currency,

Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

Protecting the unborn,

Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a
constitutional carry state,

Expanding education freedom,

Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and
entities,

Lowering prescription drug costs,

Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

Creating a universal school choice program,

Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme
Court,

...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout
his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of
nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the
largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than
1.5 million votes.

But
history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the
majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional
wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently
as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30
points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red,
including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties
overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor
DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics,
and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with
battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing
down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his
inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense
suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of
sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even
for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we
choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than
cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe
place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership,
Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education
opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden
Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that
seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to
the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered
the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's
history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:

Record tax relief

ESG prohibitions

Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering
transparency

Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

Improvements to our state's infrastructure

Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death
penalty for child rapists

The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border
crisis

Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward
school unions

Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No
leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor
DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country,
leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron
is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television
anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters,

## FDA Approves New Targeted Covid Vaccines
New vaccines targeting the omicron variant of Covid [were approved Monday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtuhDAQAL_GdEZmzcuFizR0lzYlMt71sZHByFig5OujS331SKPRfD3mh-PI-_PTbWRLSLPzhS-alZENSNAzVGgDEZCuyDa9aTtQLehqtQOg6UcTelwG5zozDth3nTGo2zA2gBVbUKCVaUCZrmvHegjUu2VRqMbBL5pEqwi5pFx_J97LSiH-pIty7dNWRbuWcpxCfwiYBEz3fdd-X_wLCpheagGTMgKmphEw-XQxyst5zzudMqCT7jhyuuiUO93yXFM5Zchpk0fgX8pyS0h5d_Vatlhli8fNMfLZD6JVz81x_O8o77f8BQAA__9hGmPe) by the Food and Drug Administration and could be available as early as next week. The new vaccines still need approval from [the Center for Disease Control](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu4zAQAL-G6mSQy9WDhYoDDup87ZXCcndpM5BFQ2Jk5O8Dp045mGYw_6_LlfKat9s_euhUU1mIaz51saF10IJfoJEpqYL6RifXB-zAIvjmPjGxeEbuevWC6L2OgUcKohQHa2OTJ7DgbXBgQ9fheBmS9hSjFTsOHL0atCq5lv3yUfJW75rWr3LqfuHyaNbpXuvzMP6PgdnATM9NX8dbvWGvmVc1MHM5s7QnMedNj5bLXjY68_55tOAxwcADoh9TxNEBWYcSJYwiUdT4uVIW4__2mFLH7CiSpGCtddxhcrHZJ3m-8rrmox8M2tuD8vpTV3-f9R0AAP__IFZp3w), which is set to issue recommendations today on who most needs the updated vaccination. Officials are positioning it as an annual shot similar to a flu shot. Unlike previous boosters, the new vaccine isn't made from components of the original Covid variants. It's designed instead for the [specific omicron variant](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGynCAUgOGnwQ4HjyhSUGxDt2lTOgiHhQTBQVYn-_SZe-tb_80_3-_n-jQxxfz6ZXZUzZfV2BYvXJmkA1AYV-ic8oiAY4dqmCWfgHEYu6AWmIbNic0iF95zgXyxcp7EhgysnGUXFTAYmRyAyWniSy88zmbbmGOLsNuIhDN0sZXa_ykxt4A-_SsX1t6WvUsqtHacZHwQ0AT0fd_9fuavRkBjpu-TgA5oUgsEdGkBKwHtnaHmOGq58KSHjx-s1GRH9-KwZkNtuaKjl7E2ZjzpHVugGW_qS93fyRDQptLHY3h9EP52VbnjjinFcxaEs9duYvq-az9j_Q8AAP__tfJtUg), which accounts for about 21% of U.S. cases.
## Vast Deposit of Lithium Discovered near Nevada
One of the [world's largest lithium deposits](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1urDAQQOGngc5oGAxeChe3odvbpkQGj2Ei_6ywWcLbR0md_hRH38dzfhr2HLf_JpAuLs1mLfymGUbRosBuxtpqR4TU1aTbYZQ9gsSu3nUP5KRSiBJA4rCqVioYx8609ABjhpo1AnYwtghj38tHoxwNZlnAwkOtS0eVBLJc0tF8Jo5lJ-fv9KajWVOovd5LeeWq-1fhVOF0XVfj0tdyZo6U809T4URriincFU6ey85nEJZeKXMRLp3RijOLYG6xkDAhxU1c6fA2C2-OjXIRuZz2Fo6jzfWh7eti7zkPqpKwBcP-96T8DfMdAAD__xkvZzQ) has been discovered in an extinct volcano along the Nevada-Oregon border, with huge implications for the transition to electric cars. Scientists estimate 20-40 million metric tons of lithium could be at the site, dwarfing deposits in Chile and Australia. Lithium is a crucial component for EV batteries, and the new supply could meet [global battery demand for decades](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAUAL8Gb1j4ge148JAFqUO6tpuF4WG_CkMENG7-vkrnziedTvdxW26GAsXt3Rw4V58WYys9cBET74CDXKBxs0cElA3O3TCpHoQC2ezzCB6V6kUnpewHmPy4DmsHclCDlb0VDc0gQIqpAzH1vbq0o8fBrKtw4jLaVSJTAh3VlNuvRLHu6MMzPTC3Nh1NmPda74XJKwPNQJ_n2R4lvhgDjZFvKwMd8SwMdKo7Zgb6kYI1MXFHxb5MT27Td3D8nk7MHAPamslya3LhPmXu0BqHhRdLGCuVWngxTwbaZH69dtvPJ701eXb3k0KgMoxMie0wFP4S6__HfgMAAP__7-tudw). Automakers have been racing to lock in supplies of lithium. The mineral is on track to triple output over the next decade, but demand for electric vehicles threatened to exceed supply. The new find will change that calculation.
## New Mexico Gun-Control Order Draws Fire
Both Democrats and Republicans attacked New Mexico Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham after she temporarily [suspended gun carry laws ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OozAUhZ_GdEbmGkMoXKShy3arlbZBtrmQO_IPsp2gvP2Iqac6xdE5-vT9eywPQ57i_scE1HVLi3GV3riIiXfAQS7QrHpDBJQN6m6YegWiB9k8tRrAwTgY6JVCOVjTC7ltFid164xYbUMaBEgxdSAmpfpbO244GGvFKm6jsxJZL3ClmnL7lSjWJ27-k96YW5dC4_Wz1qMweWcwM5jP82xDiVfHYMbIX4XBHPG8wmUKyGDer3lMufCK4UjZ5A-3JvIUuTM5fyjufH_Fwiny42U9OR4Qa-EZC5VqorteTOb3e7e__07_m6zX4yTvqQwj68UeDPkfvvq7ru8AAAD__5LAbjw)in the state under an emergency health order. Even gun-control advocates were critical of the order, which declared gun violence a [public health emergency requiring a ban](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOozAQQL_GdEZmbEgoXFxDl2uvRMYekzkZG-EhZP9-la23ftLT0_v3mB-OEuX1r9vQciyz80wvnNUoO5CgZ2iCjYiAukHbDaPpQRnQzdPG4GFR2qHpTIhDt9xHE-LYR-W8c8Y1ZEGBVmMHaux7c29vEQe3LCqo-80vGoVRGIjL0f4vlPmJMX2VFx6tL1uT7JN5r0L_ETAJmK7ramN5Z7zqhwuY9pKIyVcBU6IFD5eq5PPIMuMlN3yTL3L9-HI55HpmWc-6Y65UsnxRSY6xyrNKX3Jl4pOp5OawYb8oJarDTRi1bo7STw__vuc7AAD__5mlbCo) on open and concealed carry. Both parties said that didn't justify suspending a constitutional right. Two GOP legislators in New Mexico called for Lujan Grisham's impeachment, and the National Association for Gun Rights [filed a lawsuit](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLvOozAUhJ8GOke-4FvhYpt02XZLZM45EEcGJ8Ykytuv-Ou_m9FIo0_fv9t4iymnbfkbVwptLmOElt40cs-EZFKNsscwE0lSPQVh_KAlH6Tq78FwwFkJ54QmJy2C8YDaaInRaUGxT0FyqbgXknutB3exM5k4TRy5szAp6gZOmFqpl0dJW7vTnL_lTfUCZe1zuLf23Dv1p5PXTl7jc6PPfk5nqS1BpjPl6XgdVF8HseXYdracD1upDMoGFDMhg1jrl82pUqzrzio9CBoj0ORQ2ziB0MZZRDEpjw5AeIve9DXg85NyTrux3cCXNab8g9Z-N_U_AAD__4n1a5I) to overturn the order.

subject: Data Shows Democrat Policies are Shrinking American Life
body:

September 12, 2023 As a candidate, I've been speaking with the solid citizens of CT-4 as I traveled the District the past six months. In listening to the challenges and stresses folks regularly convey, a distressing theme running throughout their stories emerges: Between Democrat policies on Spending, Climate, Energy, Housing, Healthcare, Education, the Border, and seemingly everything else - the reality is that life for most of us is most assuredly shrinking........ Because of the disrupting impact of record-high inflation on life's necessities of food, shelter, energy and healthcare, the more optional activities of travel, recreation, entertainment and personal pursuits are being squeezed out of our lives. Indeed, the CDC just revealed that U.S. life expectancy is now 76.4 years, the shortest it's been in almost two decades. The Dean of the Harvard School of Health, Michele Williams, quite ironically, attributes that fact, which she [published](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_a8PRKO1Kgwf2np31PRimGG1mhWAX0ljaU6acqhQMB6zmy2_xS-vcCUSCt-o5HwihHyDb8WCXApG2rMd1Wvin3FPqo_CiTRwlPuHA-v7ELbOcu5ONxBKcGYyIvN99adF_HdqasyeAt_WZvMkqc9Ew4ZI8QiqwuDgg2ydKYqdyZ8fOsR25ZtlqMYpouW7uZvh4E_HlN4J8uu-NNjcOj1BiWhV0ttZEoMk5ax4G8kqsFfXV9AEA8s03Ic4JLcZVYrznFkUFHHYtjzRJS-Q1io5G80ly59HXSCh&c=dHhzZqm896e9Ck3qNYxZyXdTn2GQ-lJPIeFHGmtZ6p7UYn2KBDrhug==&ch=1nRgtc5v04E8fs7xhTOUH6VYwYwi6CPyV1DfHAb2sczyqp9sKCYb5Q==) "to the way the U.S. Healthcare system is structured." She noted that we don't do enough healthcare 'upstream' but instead, wait till the person arrives at the emergency room. If you remember the titanic public debate over ObamaCare, we contended that that entire Democrat-proposed 'restructuring' of the health insurance industry would result in people not purchasing the program's highly expensive coverages, and would instead present themselves to emergency rooms when their conditions became critical. Well, here we are - the data is in and ObamaCare is failing the American people. Here in Fairfield County, earlier this year, United Illuminating had to double its electricity generation costs because of 'Green' and other mandates proposed, driven and enacted by Democrats in their climate-panic. The result is our electric bills in Fairfield County are up 40%, while those in upstate CT using Eversource have increased up to 80%! Oil is now about $90 a barrel, driving hikes in gasoline and home heating oil, absorbing ever more of our monthly budgets and limiting our personal mobility. Speaking of mobility, if you head out today to purchase or lease a car, monthly payments for a new one will run on average $750+ while used car payments average $540+. And if you venture into the electric vehicle, EV market, you will pay 25% more! Should you be looking to move, or if you're a Millennial desperately trying to stay in your home state as you try to secure a house for your family, Democrat deficit and inflation-driven interest rates have significantly shrunk the size of the house you can buy in just 12 months. And, if you manage to find something, when you sit down to close on the mortgage, payments will be just a bit higher because the Democrat rubric of "equitable-access" requires high credit scorers to subsidize those with a lower credit score! Yep - all in the name of Socialism - oops, Equity! Then, moving from the outrageous to the simply ridiculous, Democrats seek to ban gas stoves, redesign our ceiling fans, restrict our water heaters, and control your house temperature remotely through 'smart' thermostats! And that's not to mention what they'd do if they get their hands on remote access to the proliferation of 'smart' refrigerators, TVs and other smart appliances, all being pushed through the marketplace today. Don't believe it - check out the [Demand Management](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_a8PRKO1Kgwf2np31PRimGG1mhWAX0ljaU6acqhQMB6zmy2_xS-vcCUSCt-o5HwiP644B3TEq0yNOPdAlY0u9JV3EcJnTrxRJsGgk8C9K4Zy1Xnn_7a5fXyZCmbfnHIQY-ELw1rlME_fujBqtJV0mnUR9-0Fv7w0OAgqsfDtwLQUXoKAU63u_RgCpihIN_5eQ96N6XXFKPRzU8w3URdnFG9qRylGhWmsOyNV8KyoqrnkfvOjpsBnQQ==&c=dHhzZqm896e9Ck3qNYxZyXdTn2GQ-lJPIeFHGmtZ6p7UYn2KBDrhug==&ch=1nRgtc5v04E8fs7xhTOUH6VYwYwi6CPyV1DfHAb2sczyqp9sKCYb5Q==) policy currently enacted in California. Rumblings are that Connecticut Democrats would love to emulate many of those policies here in California-East. And if you've been following my weekly updates, Jim Himes has voted for all the policies which have driven us into this nightmare: He voted FOR ObamaCare and the Green New Dream, and AGAINST 'Increasing Oil & Gas Production Act,' the 'Lower Energy Costs Act,' and the 'Save Our Gas Stoves Act,' as well as for all the sneaky and squirrelly Amendments hidden in other Bills, which enabled the regulatory strait-jacket in which we now find ourselves. America's horizons must be EXPANDED... not shrunk! There are certainly bigger-picture issues to be addressed in this campaign as well, and I'll be covering them in detail as the campaign develops. BUT the above resoundingly illustrates what Jim Himes' 15 years of promotion, defense and enactment of Democrat policies have done to the lives of us all - and we simply DO NOT HAVE TO STAND FOR IT! I was interviewed Friday by Lee Elci on the Voice of Freedom radio show and covered many of these items and the issues I believe most pressing on the citizens of the Fourth District. Audio of the interview is [here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_a8PRKO1Kgwf2np31PRimGG1mhWAX0ljaU6acqhQMB6zmy2_xS-vcCUSCt-o5HwiVZ1ppiJHON88ILLBJdqO9-85Ur9QqhDiGReNNJjc3sWbzTiqET3-HF-bElRSJ5fJ-NnwRNTuNZjDz1LEBROW9hoq1acjoQ3G&c=dHhzZqm896e9Ck3qNYxZyXdTn2GQ-lJPIeFHGmtZ6p7UYn2KBDrhug==&ch=1nRgtc5v04E8fs7xhTOUH6VYwYwi6CPyV1DfHAb2sczyqp9sKCYb5Q==) - then scroll down to the first item 'In the News.' Please help me retire Jim Himes, and return real representation to the citizens of CT here: [DONATE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_a8PRKO1Kgwf2np31PRimGG1mhWAX0ljaU6acqhQMB6zmy2_xS-vcNfyZoVz__tsoLCD4_XVxXN1Gs5Aykoepru0MxYhf7ZiyDHPphWXEcxYi7WJa8FNAQXBABt_1axphYk3Rpnv64JwqGgAOjYonNyBd_vWHleozEaNHk6F87Ag1UEZC_066Gd3dyDkvWYqBzlsI-wgc-eTbf6n2bTk5rP3uQtl3RXHcxhPHTHtEzs=&c=dHhzZqm896e9Ck3qNYxZyXdTn2GQ-lJPIeFHGmtZ6p7UYn2KBDrhug==&ch=1nRgtc5v04E8fs7xhTOUH6VYwYwi6CPyV1DfHAb2sczyqp9sKCYb5Q==)
It would be deeply appreciated. Please re-circulate this message to any and all who are interested...or should be. Help is on the way,
Bob MacGuffie Candidate for Congress [www.BobMacforCongress.com](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001_a8PRKO1Kgwf2np31PRimGG1mhWAX0ljaU6acqhQMB6zmy2_xS-vcDYm5v2UxUycVpvo2ghuaOedU9RpJzSXHMONRYnLyYCymmoPr-iUlwcqv1gKPVmuVO-KTPj_WS-gaHmMk-AT5Jlc3twgaWUCO_hmjUJyMxmw&c=dHhzZqm896e9Ck3qNYxZyXdTn2GQ-lJPIeFHGmtZ6p7UYn2KBDrhug==&ch=1nRgtc5v04E8fs7xhTOUH6VYwYwi6CPyV1DfHAb2sczyqp9sKCYb5Q==)

Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=63eaf5b830764b8baef5b00387e60b9d&_e=lifV7jUt8NlnulIlRdBaJgFTUOP_4wFbFC2t98yM77WJhZ_fYussJoEWOCnXCGJ4VmpOByP30xQmhgaGy2q06p1IOUHZpCTz1y193dyPi8vaMUl4s9tqyiBfNElBPvI-RdZDQBHCyRFM2aSw4KyoNkG74QpznVJZUt1GEiCelmqb_7ddFETqcMND-GrAgcOB9aRDA1UTYVJRXoat9PYmZYdlURAHmVksiNvmMSyGwSIjAdKM4eddBxKKkFe3Ec7JJo-V4Yg1x9l632Uhek3oe1wUYqrk3olzG3A-k5FSzL5dscnHR4KTxMBQUT7KjrgQHmr8PeZoavGI1SKaIDBVRCEmot-w3zTOL3rXdFEmN860yoMu4stokhNCOhJyfF2z3ldx-QJ5sTYfgoZc5Hnc3A%3D%3D)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. name: Becky Wagner
subject: My husband is facing 10 years in prison for defending himself
body:
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...

Dear Friend,
I wish I were writing to you under happier circumstances...
...but my hero police officer husband, Mark Wagner, is the next big target of the radical anti-police movement and I urgently need your help before they make an example out of him.
That's Mark in the picture I sent you, along with our boys Nolan and Jacob and dog Kilo.
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4e8411f7d4b24500a455bdca6fcac179&_e=uH1VZQk5AW7PoEG7nE2LqUoE2V7lFiNM7Stv7Qw7PP4Gl72zpTn-BCJ6_6vh9l5T_QrxAZpGokExAMp9ZTWIaVckLY-ZSa0HkXaxCL6JcMuyNx6Lykj85_dB18f4kWyEhYkXEDSbOjEI5rW6fY97qJCwTLR1WXXIUnyhO4-bOF8UjsAR2ZUUYL9OW5QSbAk7__mBCJMJ5jXuHgrTTdoMpyidNGSp_1wFfmUFionVP2zn_wsitqmnyaPIM3r1quS9eLw95gCXR_4DQIKkQM4wLmzG87fapLh0tmMe7RqnmKU1tdQj20_9Fk0OPA32Y-o512Wx_LV1REcf9JVcXkDsG2v0eHRIyVQ-C1Kagm1lplk%3D)
Not only is Mark a highly respected officer, he's an incredibly supportive father, a loving husband, and a fierce friend.
He's dedicated his life to protecting others. But we live in far-Left Madison, Wisconsin - and the "defund the police" mob whipped up rage, LIED about what happened, and trashed Mark's reputation.
And now Mark faces 10 YEARS behind bars for doing exactly what he was trained to do in the line of duty - and I'm scared I might lose him. [**That 's why I wrote this letter to you, someone I've never met before, to ask for your help.**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4e8411f7d4b24500a455bdca6fcac179&_e=uH1VZQk5AW7PoEG7nE2LqUoE2V7lFiNM7Stv7Qw7PP4Gl72zpTn-BCJ6_6vh9l5T_QrxAZpGokExAMp9ZTWIaVckLY-ZSa0HkXaxCL6JcMuyNx6Lykj85_dB18f4kWyEhYkXEDSbOjEI5rW6fY97qJCwTLR1WXXIUnyhO4-bOF8UjsAR2ZUUYL9OW5QSbAk70XDdWwG4Ds3_9ZEhmoMKgEml07g8hgT0odNDp0eSteSj_mPHsjXua-3XlmdQAiFVb3tcHrHSmOkq56r_QCtDEobv1a_ixRXcb0fGNEVYneKCLIJuexCq2yVRiDi_dcCGVbEKfM1-Uy2iVWxt2Q6Qi26wNPpLg-9SiC634j0-RTw%3D)
But first, let me explain what happened...
On the morning of February 3, 2022, Mark and other officers tried to arrest a _violent_ _criminal_ named Quadren Wilson.
Wilson has a rap sheet a mile long with dozens of arrests for drug distribution, theft, witness intimidation, battery, eluding police, and more. He was wanted for allegedly dealing fentanyl to a man found dead in a restaurant bathroom.
Mark's arrest team planned to capture Wilson in his vehicle using a containment strategy. They pulled in their trucks to block his car on both ends. But Wilson floored the accelerator, spinning his wheels wildly in a desperate attempt to escape justice.
Mark and another officer exited their vehicle to make the arrest. Mark was holding one of those big POLICE shields and had his gun drawn. But Wilson refused Mark's commands to show his hands, continuing to spin his wheels and try to force his way out.
With the wheels screeching and smoking, Mark and the other officer saw Wilson reach into the center console and pull his hand up.
Mark thought Wilson had a gun. He heard what he thought was gunfire. Then Mark felt something hit the shield he was holding and push him backward.** **
**Both Mark and the other officer responded to this life-threatening situation by firing into the vehicle.**
Mark believed his life and his fellow officers' lives were in danger. He did what he was trained to do and stopped the threat.
Thankfully, Wilson survived and no one else was injured. But because Wilson is black and Mark is white - anti-police radicals jumped at the chance to target Mark.
Protesters drummed up a racial firestorm by spreading lies that Wilson "had his hands up" and that he "was shot five times in the back." The corrupt liberal media repeated these lies and painted my husband as a monster.
And on September 22, 2022, the liberal District Attorney caved to the mob and filed BOGUS felony charges against Mark. **Now Mark faces 10 YEARS in prison.**
[**_Now I hope you can see why I 'm turning to you for help today._**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4e8411f7d4b24500a455bdca6fcac179&_e=uH1VZQk5AW7PoEG7nE2LqUoE2V7lFiNM7Stv7Qw7PP4Gl72zpTn-BCJ6_6vh9l5T_QrxAZpGokExAMp9ZTWIaVckLY-ZSa0HkXaxCL6JcMuyNx6Lykj85_dB18f4kWyEhYkXEDSbOjEI5rW6fY97qJCwTLR1WXXIUnyhO4-bOF8UjsAR2ZUUYL9OW5QSbAk7e37reghvulGfJRcfsFC4iqwL4_AmNWbhrMem4DXmyShgSzsFbuQaVYTK0X1YKlMq_VfPuNRa75hBMrBa7WOtAuTo7IDICNbu7GPtf-YZOtjB4vfDfheqduc2iviAZ-96zYEljJOeGMcnCzqjFcB8ZnuM3jTjvoO-balbMTL_2l0%3D)
Mark dedicated his life to helping others. He's spent 30 years in law enforcement, most of them with the Milwaukee Police Department (MPD).
We knew fighting alone against the anti-police movement here in Wisconsin would be impossible and our hope that justice would prevail was quickly fading when we received a call from **the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF)** offering to help Mark.
This incredible organization helps innocent officers, like my husband, who have been unfairly prosecuted for split-second, use-of-force decisions in the line of duty.
Law and justice experts like President Ronald Reagan's Attorney General Edwin Meese and former FBI Assistant Director Ronald Hosko serve on LELDF's Board. LELDF's president, Jason Johnson, served over 20 years as a police officer, including as Deputy Commissioner of the Baltimore Police Department.
In short, these are experts when it comes to policing. And they thoroughly vet cases to determine if an officer was wrongly accused or charged before deciding to help.
They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses, whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court. And they do it all free of charge!
But LELDF doesn't receive any money from the government to help police officers facing unjust charges. They're funded entirely by the generous support of folks like you who can recognize a miscarriage of justice and want to help fix it.
This is why I reached out to you today. I needed to ask you a very important question:
[**_Will you please help my husband Mark fight the unjust charges against him and clear his name by rushing a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF today?_**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4e8411f7d4b24500a455bdca6fcac179&_e=uH1VZQk5AW7PoEG7nE2LqUoE2V7lFiNM7Stv7Qw7PP4Gl72zpTn-BCJ6_6vh9l5T_QrxAZpGokExAMp9ZTWIaVckLY-ZSa0HkXaxCL6JcMuyNx6Lykj85_dB18f4kWyEhYkXEDSbOjEI5rW6fY97qJCwTLR1WXXIUnyhO4-bOF8UjsAR2ZUUYL9OW5QSbAk7Sq13ynGk4_A6vxfbxtaGQAuuQ3AXbMZ0_1YV5f9OlZviQx3zRPLd1BrCeSP6TJl4-4V6fvyW2iooWRDW6jntG56MXNewRFtsfxDj2sWc_MzSDDN_jDIoO52MB5SzdNNd_5xd13DhssjA2fznNKkgfn2zkAMj82s2-tndljqwSjQ%3D)
Your kind gift today of $35, $50, or $100 to help Mark will mean so much to my family.
Or, if you're blessed with the means to help with a gift of $250, $500, or even $1,000 or more, I pray you will so my husband doesn't spend 10 YEARS behind bars away from his family.
Right now, LELDF is preparing to ramp up legal action in Mark's case. [**So please follow this link to make your tax-deductible donation right away.**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4e8411f7d4b24500a455bdca6fcac179&_e=uH1VZQk5AW7PoEG7nE2LqUoE2V7lFiNM7Stv7Qw7PP4Gl72zpTn-BCJ6_6vh9l5T_QrxAZpGokExAMp9ZTWIaVckLY-ZSa0HkXaxCL6JcMuyNx6Lykj85_dB18f4kWyEhYkXEDSbOjEI5rW6fY97qJCwTLR1WXXIUnyhO4-bOF8UjsAR2ZUUYL9OW5QSbAk7FPNo6IPJAo6IC1UdnsXLZu78tW4a7dCZqjWiqMdiI1_zXH5Tf18KYufM-1blRl1gieTQ_3Ct8PebDZjPNT2iRU5OPUfhgkhwe8qe7DYc5QR-_9ABigy5GUB2bkbrxygDhJI3tYKpZys8Td5-zsQnunU6pAL2GEqwIlQNUTGqzKE%3D)
Any gift amount you can send today is truly a blessing. No matter what you're able to give, please say a prayer for Mark and our family.
Thank you in advance for your generous support of my family and LELDF.
With deepest gratitude,
Becky Wagner
P.S. Mark is the type of person who'd offer to donate a kidney to a friend in need just because it's the right thing to do. In fact, that's exactly what he did when he donated one of his kidneys to his former partner of more than a decade! Mark didn't even let his partner know he got checked out as a potential donor. He just said that his partner had young kids who needed him to be around and it was the right thing to do.

Peter - The Cornel West Campaign released a press statement today with the announcement: Los Angeles - Presidential candidate Cornel West today welcomed Peter Daou to his presidential campaign in the role of Campaign Manager. A respected activist, adviser, writer, and musician, Daou has more than 20 years of national political experience and was described by the New York Times as “one of the most prominent political bloggers in the nation.” He has advised major progressive organizations and has held senior positions in several Democratic presidential campaigns. Daou has been an Independent since 2020 and supported the Green Party in the 2020 election. Before entering the political arena, Daou was a prolific keyboardist and remixer, appearing on recordings by artists including Miles Davis, Diana Ross, Janet Jackson, and Mariah Carey. Says Daou of his new role on the West campaign: “It is an honor to be part of Dr. Cornel West's historic campaign for president. Dr. West is a man of deep personal integrity, great accomplishment, and far-reaching vision. His presence in the 2024 race gives voters an exceptional choice for truth and justice beyond the corrupt and corrosive duopoly. Democracy means choice, it means options for voters, not coronations and vote-shaming. It is long past time to _practice_ democracy rather than just pay it lip service. I intend to work with Dr. West, his incredible team, the Green Party, and our allies across the political spectrum to give voice to the people

Hold onto your seats because we're in the midst of a seismic shift in the battle for fair maps and justice in Alabama. The headlines speak volumes:
* * *
* **NPR:** "Alabama congressional map struck down again for diluting Black voting power"
* **CNN:** "Federal Court strikes down congressional map after legislature snubbed Supreme Court"
* **Washington Post:** "Federal court blocks Alabama's congressional map, orders new lines drawn"
* **Alabama Reflector:** "Federal court blocks Alabama's congressional map, orders new lines drawn"

* * *
In a groundbreaking decision, a three-judge federal court has just delivered a resounding verdict: [**Alabama's remedial map, a supposed remedy to the deep-rooted gerrymandering problem, is unusable for any election.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/69582740/426622862/-872582718?refcode=20230908_AOTL_F_ALNews_RedLite&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIxODFkY2U2LTYzNTEtZWUxMS05OTM3LTAwMjI0ODMyZTgxMSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=faiAKOQtH53RJwT9vahDedhZlpkBB5X0MkIXEdH8WdM=) This marks an extraordinary leap towards achieving fair representation for all Alabamians...
But it’s not over until it’s over. The court has handed the people of Alabama a golden opportunity with a pivotal deadline at the end of this month, requiring the creation of a new congressional map.

subject: Peter, there’s one thing you need to know about our Senate race
body:
If there’s one thing you need to know about our Senate race, it’s that MAGA Republicans see no greater threat to their power than yours truly.
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcad17c1c-2b0c-442b-9889-eb68fb979b1f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, if there’s one thing you need to know about our Senate race, it’s that MAGA Republicans see no greater threat to their power than yours truly. Just look at how they’ve reacted in the last six months since we announced this campaign: As soon as Kevin McCarthy had scraped by in the Speaker election — with a bare minimum number of votes after his fifteenth humiliating attempt — he removed me as the top Democrat on the Intelligence Committee. McCarthy is so weak that his chief antagonists in the Speaker’s race — like Matt Gaetz and Anna Paulina Luna — have hijacked floor proceedings time and again to target me even further with political attacks. Introducing legislation to bar me from receiving classified information. Censuring me in political retaliation for investigating and impeaching Donald Trump. Even trying to fine me $16 million. And Trump himself continues to attack me too. Including calling me out by name in an exclusive sit-down interview with Fox News last week, and expressing his hope that I will not be elected to the Senate. Why do they continue to make me the target of their attacks? Because time and again, when Trump has violated the law and abused his power by...
* Soliciting and using Russian help in the 2016 election
* Leveraging his office and U.S. military aid to Ukraine to get Zelenskyy to smear Joe Biden
* Inciting the deadly insurrection to stop the peaceful transfer of power on January 6

...I’ve stood up again and again to say it isn’t okay. It’s criminal. Investigating foreign interference in our elections. Impeaching him for abusing his oath of office. Speaking the truth about what Trump knew and did on January 6. MAGA Republicans do not want to see Californians elect me to represent them in the Senate, because no one has stood up to Trump and his cronies as often and as effectively as I have. For years. They aren’t going to stop attacking me or our campaign. And very often I’m going to need your help to respond. That’s why I’m asking: [Will you split $10 or any amount to Blue Amp Action and my Senate campaign today to help us respond to Trump and MAGA Republicans’ attacks and keep up the fight for our democracy and an economy that works for all?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T60e81e5d-6df8-4eaf-8449-b226f9f9b418/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zecottvsfohjppjalbrmhhckend8g0okg1uevqr0_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj62pr0c9h2bs)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z5bbfqm1hboroki019cei0i9lk06ansbk23uisr0_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj62pr0c9h2bs)**

Wishing you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

name: Marjorie Dannenfelser
subject: We desperately need your voice!
body:
Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?

| [ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c22495%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PHIYDd14apkz7iltzHBJIg&sysid=1)
---
Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion.

I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. **_We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion._**

The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. [Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c22496%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6BejmQAAFi9ZHONZiwmAaw&sysid=1)

When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events.
[SIGN THE PLEDGE »](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c22497%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ALXMgv624no97HR7weUnvg&sysid=1)
| **I know that you care about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every child is welcomed and valued.**
---
For LIFE,

Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America

Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America
2776 S. Arlington Mill Dr.
PO Box 803
Arlington, VA, 22206

name: Majorie Dannenfelser
subject: Let our lawmakers know you stand for life!
body:
Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?

| [ ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8hpqvagf16imjeoqq2l7ub633o20s6erk72n538_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj66oj5c9h2bs)
---
Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion.

I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. **_We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion._**

The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. [Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhpch6413md766g7iljrcsoiskv3e0rramrbfcd8_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj66oj5c9h2bs)

When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events.

[SIGN THE PLEDGE »](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4rmjus04u7cncf728i1t75ts40r5p40hqhk2spo_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj66oj5c9h2bs)
| **I know that you care about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every child is welcomed and valued.**
---
For LIFE,

Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America

Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America
2776 S. Arlington Mill Dr.
PO Box 803
Arlington, VA, 22206

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
I’m reaching out today about an important issue that's close to my heart

|
---
| | | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2znke0qmg719nusr99tnhvta51mdl8qlnrfv0160o_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj66oj6c9h2bs)
---
| Dear Fellow Patriot,

I hope this message finds you well. I'm reaching out today about an important issue that's close to my heart and, I believe, relevant to all of us.

In the current climate, our religious liberty, a foundational tenet of our nation, faces an increasing number of challenges. These are especially concerning for those of us who hold to biblical and faith-based values. [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z7m8s728rpqpuvr3q69p8irjegp38u5bfqlknk90_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj66oj6c9h2bs)
With societal shifts and new legal precedents, including the recently passed Respect for Marriage Act, the ability to practice and express our faith openly may face unprecedented threats.

These changes may allow the federal government to exert pressure on schools, businesses, and organizations that adhere to their religious beliefs. I fear this might lead to intensified legal persecution against those wishing to live according to their faith.

As engaged citizens, it's crucial we understand this situation and its potential impact on our religious freedom.

Please take a moment to share your insights by completing this 2-minute survey: [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zoe9jsd61svr1o87jksujm4vjr17o1tubqkpc4i8_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj66oj6c9h2bs)

Your contribution will guide our efforts to alert fellow Americans of the threats to our religious liberty and defend our First Amendment rights.

Let's uphold the integrity of our Constitution and protect the pillars that make our nation great: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Yours sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

body:
The modern primary system of choosing a presidential nominee developed to replace shady backroom deals among party insiders with a transparent, democratic process.

| [ ](https://www.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_hands_off_our_votes2&n=1)
---
Peter -- The modern primary system of choosing a presidential nominee developed to replace shady backroom deals among party insiders with a transparent, democratic process. [](https://www.kennedy24.com/dnc-destroying-democracy?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_hands_off_our_votes2&n=2) Unfortunately, the Democratic National Committee is trying to bring back the days of insider crony politics. But now you can do something about it! Our campaign is [circulating ](https://fairvote.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_hands_off_our_votes2&n=3)[a petition](https://fairvote.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_hands_off_our_votes2&n=4)[ link](https://fairvote.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_hands_off_our_votes2&n=5) to pressure the DNC into running a fair and free primary election. We urge you to sign the petition and share it with friends – whether or not you are a Democrat, and whether or not they support Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. Why? Because an undemocratic primary is bad for democracy. [](https://fairvote.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_hands_off_our_votes2&n=6) | [](https://fairvote.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_hands_off_our_votes2&n=7 "Sign The Petition") [Sign The Petition](https://fairvote.kennedy24.com/?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=petition_hands_off_our_votes2&n=7)
---
Here are some of the things the DNC is doing to rig the primary:
* The DNC has revoked New Hampshire’s century-old status as the first primary state. The new first state is South Carolina — which President Biden won, in contrast to losing New Hampshire and Iowa.
* The DNC has drafted rules that if any candidate sets foot in New Hampshire, no votes cast for that candidate will count. Regardless of his margin of victory, Mr. Kennedy would receive zero delegates. The DNC is also demanding Iowa change its voting process or face similar sanctions.

Dear Friends,

I wholeheartedly applaud Governor Youngkin for pardoning Scott Smith, the Loudoun County father who was arrested at a school board meeting for expressing his outrage regarding a coverup by the Loudoun County public school system after his daughter was raped.

We remember the story well. [RTD](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wcV0sLKKpQzHK43KFWOnFVzbQyrUI0_--rLZJiSwyGguEcUbkd_ykzYWJEM2xIQUp7X5jI1tmIvqFKVYcsHMmmlVw4yqiS5Osa3_-5nk3xlGXQjLffsKO4uIy81PDZNW8s0S72-GFAMuqduo1bj5S1BIcy5ZRPRvtZ2-GNWgH7oFX58XcZp1zqn2juBJA-K3xmMmGr-fZgSmvBbddjbvHGxKhYYO_TlxhWI1hQ2ZiqHs0aU2bufY-RUi0FZvcIYciY_n9CU5Ai6CMgQNa36aWdCC8aKSJb60nCTfPoUIAZJ9P6lr4GIh44eBSMBqKCMEGAfzud_JwllmW4WzxhxDyXlkShr3mp1r1e3VDGaOeomGY5HwSjRi3CKQLvFcn3RBGaPqxKFwbK86GxVNMvZSfrViCMyKdqpEtuCN6aJrV-uIO7FH_mFWld_PEQljQtWZhFL1ybHvFOM=&c=JhP3zGv_cg6TMWqjhBIRWQieBGhpuTrlobF2zynKkdbP7wlHeGhQWg==&ch=QtXAp-de--sNSvp2Z4KnsypoaGXeSut9y0qIg6hMXcQt7Fyfpy_Oew==) described it this way- "The assailant, a student at Stone Bridge High School, sexually assaulted Smith's daughter in a campus bathroom in May 2021. The assailant was then transferred to the county's Broad Run High School, where he abducted and sexually assaulted another girl at school just five months later."

Loudoun County eventually fired their school superintendent for his involvement in the coverup.

A huge thanks also to Senator Bill Stanley who served as legal counsel for the family.

Please continue to pray for healing for Smith's family as they deal with such incredible trauma.

For God & Country,

name: Majorie Dannenfelser
subject: We desperately need your voice!
body:
Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?

| [ ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9n537tuop240lrhrg1cdc0dnd4n3j0627fkeab0_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj69o71cph2bs)
---
Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion.

I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. **_We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion._**

The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. [Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z6dbceba71epmjv4qbccbvr150oi16erqjp90j00_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj69o71cph2bs)

When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events.

[SIGN THE PLEDGE »](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmet7v26ljeaafgelj2vtm05fvj6dr3bsn53uo20_rp22sh2s8i66p71clj69o71cph2bs)
| **I know that you care about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every child is welcomed and valued.**
---
For LIFE,

Marjorie Dannenfelser
President, Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America

Susan B. Anthony Pro-Life America
2776 S. Arlington Mill Dr.
PO Box 803
Arlington, VA, 22206

Pro Life Update

subject: Victor Davis Hanson: Victory and the Savior Generals
body:
I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions.

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zqt1hc6jiho7is7unmdv6i7q51ef2v0ut08ahbl0_rp22sh2s8i66p71clgm8o31cph2bs)

| | Dear Friend, [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2ushujr0d8ghgkvh0b63evt5g2fs62ll2bpq7r0_rp22sh2s8i66p71clgm8o31cph2bs)
Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zrr8pf6fo73ttrqf8a97rgja8fkgkhn6ih4o48r8_rp22sh2s8i66p71clgm8o31cph2bs)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zl21mghtlecmodibmig6rdiccfsuqb6622svuc7g_rp22sh2s8i66p71clgm8o31cph2bs)**

Wishing you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

Greg Stamps | Online Development
Hoover Institution | Stanford University

Over more than one hundred years, Hoover’s work has directly led to policies that have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the United States and around the world._

### MTFC calls for tax cuts, ILFC calls for end to teacher union cash
| | [Andy Roth](https://substack.com/redirect/7fbbe0d0-bcb8-456b-8e51-286aab9663cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1424602&post_id=136958690&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTM2OTU4NjkwLCJpYXQiOjE2OTQ1MjcyNDEsImV4cCI6MTY5NzExOTI0MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTE0MjQ2MDIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.YyT5A33kcD0GeN6zurxc8aNMdBeddFHdMHqFyjxK7is)

Friends,
We have written several [emails](https://substack.com/redirect/4e5a2971-55c7-4431-ac11-a9ae4ad97aa7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at this point about the marxists at the American Library Association (ALA). They are the backbone of our nation's library system, they have a ton of power and taxpayer money behind them, they fight to put drag queen story hours in libraries while trying to get Kirk Cameron events cancelled, and they elected a self-described marxist named Emily Drabinski as their president last year.
The ALA doesn't try to hide their intentions. They are loud and proud about wanting to use the influence they have over libraries to indoctrinate our kids and that is why Freedom Caucuses have been fighting to get state and local library associations to cut all ties.
In case you still weren't convinced of their toxic influence, Drabinksi ripped the mask completely off last week when she attended a Socialism conference in Chicago and full out said that libraries, as well as schools, need to be "sites of socialist organizing."
**WATCH:**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/1c1b4e56-6ccd-41cf-beea-7519e633b491?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
There is no reason why our tax dollars should be funding this organization that has made their intentions known to socially engineer America's youth. We will fight every single day to not just make that happen, but ostracize them from polite society.
**Victory for landowners in South Dakota**
Ever since a company called Summit Carbon Solutions filed over 100+ eminent domain lawsuits last spring against landowners in South Dakota to steal their property for a carbon capture pipeline, the **South Dakota Freedom Caucus** has been at the forefront of shutting it down.
The pipeline would provide no economic benefit to the people of the state, but merely exist to extract carbon from ethanol plants in Iowa and store it under the ground.
Well, we are excited to announce that the South Dakota Public Utilities Commission voted unanimously today to reject the permit for the pipeline. Property rights for now are protected. But the legislature must take action to codify protections from eminent domain into law, an effort the SD Freedom Caucus will lead. [Read the SDFC's statement here.](https://substack.com/redirect/860f2e12-8da3-48e8-8c4e-d02b75292c85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Illinois ' fight against the powerful teachers' unions**
Back in May, Illinois Democrats and Gov. JB Pritzker betrayed families by [defunding](https://substack.com/redirect/1a1e1761-2f24-4d04-be06-c139ba660c1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a school choice program funded by private donations that served over 9,000 working class children. At the behest of the powerful state teachers' unions, kids will now be stuck in failing public schools with no way out.
The decision obviously outraged the **IL Freedom Caucus** , but many of the legislature's Republicans did not feel the same way. Believe it or not, 75% of Illinois House Republicans take money from the teachers' union. It's worse in the Illinois Senate with 88%.
Accepting money from teachers' unions should be antithetical to the Republican Party.
That's why the IL Freedom Caucus is now calling on the Illinois GOP to adopt a new rule banning members from accepting teachers' union donations and immediately disqualifying any who do from the party. We will ensure that the GOP always remains the party that puts parents and children before special interests. [Read the ILFC statement here.](https://substack.com/redirect/83500ee3-7f90-4d6e-b0c1-6a6c6826310e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Montana special session to cut taxes**
Montana may be a conservative state, but property taxes remain way too high. Additionally, the state is on track to have nearly $1B in surplus tax revenues that special interests would love to use to grow government.
As a result, the **MT Freedom Caucus** is now calling for a special session of the legislature to address two areas: Enacting a taxpayer bill of rights and ensuring that the excess funds are returned to the people.
Here's the kicker - Montana's legislature only convenes every other year. That's why it's necessary to have a special session NOW rather than allow the government to hold onto that huge surplus until January 2025. [Read the MTFC statement here.](https://substack.com/redirect/e1e7a84a-85b6-4d5f-86c3-4e4684fa4a30?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Arizona and Pennsylvania fight back against new COVID mandates**
Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice, shame on me. That's the story when it comes to the rumors that Democrat politicians may try to bring back COVID mandates that devastated our country.
In 2021, the people of Pennsylvania curbed the power of the executive branch by voting in favor of a ballot measure to give sole authority over extending a state of emergency to the legislature. The **PA Freedom Caucus** released a [statement](https://substack.com/redirect/29d41bea-8c5d-41ab-9985-cdcef0d933e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) warning the administration of Democrat Gov. Josh Shapiro that any attempts to lock Pennsylvanians down, force them to wear a mask, or take a vaccine will immediately be shut down.
Similarly, any attempts in Arizona from the administration of Democrat Gov. Katie Hobbs will also go down in flames. The **AZ Freedom Caucus** has already passed bills that made it impossible for any government in AZ to strip a business of its operating license during a pandemic, prohibit the forced masking of children in school, and block the government from requiring businesses to enforce any covid mandates.
Ballot measures will also be up for a vote in 2024 to significantly rein in the executive branch's authoritarian power.
We will never let radical politicians lock you down once again.
**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**
_President
State Freedom Caucus Network_

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:**

Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com?subject=null&body=null)
**To Mark NFL Week One, Tell It Like It Is PAC Launches “End Zone” TV Ad Invoking President Reagan**
**ARLINGTON, VA —** Today, Tell It Like It Is PAC released its latest television ad, the third of the 2024 cycle. Entitled “End Zone,” the :30 second spot is part of a six-figure buy that will air statewide on broadcast and cable in New Hampshire and across digital platforms starting Tuesday.
The ad includes footage of Governor Christie from a televised town hall event discussing the differences between himself and the rest of the GOP field. No other candidate in this race has been tested like Governor Christie - for eight years he governed as a conservative and got results in deep blue New Jersey, where he had a Democratic legislature.
Governor Christie got Democrats to agree with him to cap property taxes, eliminate the estate tax, and pass pension reform against the public teachers union.
The last time America faced such division, inflation, and a diminished role in the world, the nation turned to a Republican governor from a blue state, Ronald Reagan. In 2024, history is poised to repeat itself.
**“End Zone”**
[](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=7b899eca2b&e=d0a9afa930)
**TRANSCRIPT FOR “END ZONE” (TV:30):**
**Chris Christie:** _Ronald Reagan used to say the guy who disagrees with you twenty percent of the time is not your twenty percent enemy._
_He’s your eighty percent friend._
_I governed the state I got a two percent cap on property taxes through a Democratic legislature._
_I got pension reform against the public teacher’s union._
_I got the democrats to eliminate the estate tax._
_What I want to do for you is bring the skills that I had for eight years in New Jersey._
_Look across from people who I don’t agree with to work with them to put touchdowns in the end zone._

RE: mask mandates in ID... |
---
| | COVID-19 is still on our minds, and it's time for action.

I'm calling for **[a ban on mask mandates in I](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=2b78171a2c&e=dea908e0fe "Sign the petition here")[daho](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=97373fcf84&e=dea908e0fe)**, and I'm asking you to join me.

You've seen the news...

Mask mandates are making a comeback in places like businesses, schools, and healthcare facilities.

It's a pressing issue that we can't afford to ignore.

Even though the Idaho Senate**FAILED** to tackle mask-related bills in the past, we must do so ASAP.

To be clear: masks haven't been proven to effectively stop COVID-19, and the scientific evidence supports this fact.

So it's high time we move away from ineffective mandates and __assert our freedom as Idahoans__.

This is a discussion we should reopen right away, especially considering the Senate's previous inaction when the House passed mask-related bills in 2021 and 2022.

It's time to put an end to this passive approach.

Our liberties are too precious to allow them to be squashed as they were during the "pandemic."

**The time to act is right now.**

And I'm asking for your support.

➡️ **[Click here to sign my petition saying NO to mask mandates in Idaho](https://votelenney.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7ce84224f3cc6e52f7633cc60&id=35cf6eee17&e=dea908e0fe "sign it")**

Because your voice matters and your involvement could make a significant difference for our community and the future of our children.

Thanks for taking the time to consider this important issue.

Cheers,

Brian

Hi there, it’s Greg Stanton.

September 30th is my FEC fundraising deadline, so I’m reaching out to let you know what my plan is this month. I hope you’ll let me explain, but if you’re already with me, chip in now.

Use this link → https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eoq-sept23?refcode=em_fr_2023.09.12_b1_gs_all&amount=30

FEC deadlines are real. This isn’t some BS, made-up fundraising goal. After this deadline, we’ll have to report exactly how much we raised and from how many people – and that report will get released to the public.

Pundits, reporters, Kelly Cooper, and his GOP allies will all judge the strength of our campaign based on what we report. If we don’t raise enough, they could smell blood in the water and begin pouring money into the district to flip it red.
