| **I’m excited to announce that the Moms for America Action have endorsed my candidacy to serve Texans in Congress!**

_**The mama bears of America want to see their elected officials**_ **DELIVER** on our shared values of free enterprise, limited government, individual freedoms and national sovereignty – and I’m ready to put my words into action for them – and YOU!

subject: 5 reasons for $5
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Brittany Pettersen for Colorado
body:
There aren’t that many stories like mine in Congress.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69603537/426679589/-1558620660?refcode=email_091023_5reasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjVlZWQ1ZC03YzUxLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dDTlLwrpn6P4AoTr_GEuXB2TgGwFZ9TiHnkxAScfpE0=) **** Team, I'll be candid: I'm emailing today because we're coming off a summer fundraising slump. This isn't cause for panic — most campaigns raise less money during the summer — but unlike other candidates, I represent a district that right-wing extremists here in Colorado tried hard to flip red last year. **We need to be prepared to face down similar attacks if we're going to win this seat and retake our House majority next year. If you already know you’re with us and you're able to pitch in a few dollars to help us out, here is a secure link to do so: [secure.actblue.com/donate/september-bp-email](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69603538/426679590/1868297723?refcode=email_091023_5reasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjVlZWQ1ZC03YzUxLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dDTlLwrpn6P4AoTr_GEuXB2TgGwFZ9TiHnkxAScfpE0=)** But if you’re not yet convinced, and need some more information about why this fight, right here, right now, is so important, then here are five reasons I’m asking for your support today: **1) There aren’t that many stories like mine in Congress.** To put myself through school, I waited tables, worked registers, served drinks — whatever it took to make ends meet and make my tuition payments. And I’m fighting hard every day in Congress for the regular people whose needs so often go overlooked in favor of special interests. **2) I will always do everything I possibly can to protect your civil rights.** Whether it’s the right to an abortion, the right to vote, the right to be free from discrimination regardless of who you are or who you love — I will always stand up for Americans’ fundamental freedoms. **3) Despite the challenges, I’m still working to make bipartisan progress.** I will never go against our fundamental values, but there are still opportunities to get important things done. In my first eight months on the job, I’ve put forward bipartisan legislation to tackle the opioid epidemic, improve mental health services in schools, and help Colorado families struggling with rising costs. **4) Right-wing super PACs tried hard to defeat me last year — and they’re going to try just as hard to stop me from getting re-elected.** The attacks we can expect are as vicious and personal as it gets, and we need the resources ahead of time to fight back and get the truth out. **5) This is a must-win seat if we’re going to retake our House Majority and stop Kevin McCarthy from serving another term as Speaker.** McCarthy hasn’t just put forward a horrendous policy agenda — he’s empowered extremists like Lauren Boebert and Marjorie Taylor Greene. Taking House control away from McCarthy means taking it away from all the extremists he spends his days catering to. **Team, if I’ve convinced you that this campaign matters, then I need your support today to put us on a path to victory — because unlike others, I can’t write myself a giant check, and I don’t cater to corporate special interests.** **[So can you pitch in $5 — or any amount that works for you — to help us catch up to our fundraising goal? Every single dollar goes such a long way.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69603539/426679591/-1558620660?refcode=email_091023_5reasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjVlZWQ1ZC03YzUxLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dDTlLwrpn6P4AoTr_GEuXB2TgGwFZ9TiHnkxAScfpE0=)** | | [DONATE $5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69603540/426679592/1868297723?refcode=email_091023_5reasons&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MjVlZWQ1ZC03YzUxLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dDTlLwrpn6P4AoTr_GEuXB2TgGwFZ9TiHnkxAScfpE0=)

| | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

Yesterday was the 22nd anniversary of the 9-11 terrorist attacks on our country.

The front page of the local newspaper had a headline about the Moroccan earthquake, the parking problem in Easton, and the Eagles game. There were stories about a rained-out Grateful Dead tribute band and the Muhammed Ali training site. Further along, we learned how to be a better boss, how to get the social security benefits we deserve, and how to survive a recession.

On page 9, after the article, “3 timeless business lessons I learned from my dogs,” readers encountered the first reminder of the day’s anniversary. It was a full-page ad commemorating 9-11 paid for by American Bank.

Ironically, it said, “We Will Never Forget."

Besides that advertisement, and another from Embassy Bank (thank you both), there was nothing about 9-11 in the newspaper except a syndicated piece from some guy in California. It featured a picture of Hillary Clinton and Charles Shumer clapping at the reopening of the New York Stock Exchange.

Here’s a different picture. This is my friend and mentor Jim McGovern (Guvvy) in the Middle East. He went to war TEN TIMES. As a part-time Guardsman, he would put on his uniform, go to the combat zone, and then return home to his family and his teaching job. Nobody should have to go to war TEN TIMES.

The lessons learned from the wars that followed 9-11 must be applied to future conflicts, or else we will just repeat our mistakes. Veterans and first responders don't forget 9-11 even if others have moved on.

Guvvy, thank you for your service, along with all our brothers and sisters in uniform. And God Bless all the innocent victims whose lives were changed forever on that tragic day.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a husband and father who has lived in the Lehigh Valley for 40 years. He's the founder of a successful technology company and a 28-year veteran of the U.S. Armed Forces. Kevin's not running for Congress because he needs a job. He's running because he's got the experience, vision, and courage to defend our American way of life. _

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

Fellow Conservative,

My name is Tim Sheehy - I’m a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot.

I’ll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I’m answering the call again. America needs true conservative leaders who will set-up and serve our GREAT nation. **My next mission is to defeat Liberal Democrat Senator Jon Tester and end his near quarter century political career.**

You may not know me yet, although I hope to change that today, but you do know what I stand for as a Navy SEAL; I’ve fought for you, for our freedoms and liberties, to protect and defend our nation from those who wish to do us harm on their own soil.

**My friend Sen. Tom Cotton’s introduction at the top of this email comes because he believes that I’m the one Republican in Montana who can send Jon Tester out to pasture once and for all**.

subject: A kiss from a Democrat?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE FRIENDS OF DR
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruralbob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruralbob]
A Democrat Campaigning in Rural America
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruralbob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruralbob]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruralbob]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruralbob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruralbob]
,
I'm writing to you at 5 a.m. from a friend's house where my wife Peggy and I crash when we are campaigning below the bridge. Not many hotels for us. We need to save money.
No fancy dinners, just local mom n' pop cafes, a lot of gas station food, trail mix, and Diet Coke. I've already put on 10,000 miles this cycle on the F150, traversing our massive district the size of Ireland. 36 counties. No stopping.
This weekend's mileage: over 500 miles.
I walked the parade with the Presque Isle Dems yesterday at the Posen Potato Festival and passed out Hershey Kisses to voters who are demographically likely rural Republicans. I'd say, "Have a kiss from a Democrat."
Hundreds of smiles and well wishes. One grumpy guy.
At events like Saturday's barn party with Cheboygan, Peggy gets photos with her cell phone [https://www.facebook.com/drboblorinser/photos] , asks for petition signatures, and collects small donations. I mingle, address the crowd, and answer as many questions as possible.
We're usually the first ones to arrive and the last to leave. Like at Charlevox's family farm fundraiser, our gracious hosts help us find places to stay.
My team works from home. We send back photos and updates, Zoom on the road with spotty hotspot cell coverage (Thanks a lot, do-nothing Rep. Bergman), and grind, grind, grind — day after day, week after week.
This is pure grassroots campaigning , and I still have a day job trying to keep my county safe and healthy as the medical director for the health department.
, I'll always be honest; I love connecting with voters, but I hate fundraising. Money and politics don't mix well. A candidate's merit should dictate their success, not the size of their campaign fund.
Campaign finance reform is long overdue. Our democracy should represent the voices of the many, not just the wealthy.
But this is the reality. To win, we have to fight. To fight, we need funds, especially to campaign in the second-largest district east of the Mississippi — next to nearly the entire state of Maine.
It's been a challenging quarter to raise money, but we must keep going.
I know our online presence is impressive and professional, but no political apparatus is doing it for us. To save money, we turn away vendors and consultants and do everything in-house and on a dime. My team is just that good.
No corporate PACs, no dark money, no ultra-wealthy donors. It's just us; folks like you and me.
We've already been campaigning hard, we have more than a year yet still to go, and I've been dipping into my pocket to keep up this work. I can't do it alone. I need your help.
If you've given recently, my gratitude is eternal. Consider this a campaign update and thank you!
Your support won't just fuel our campaign — it will help fuel the change everyday hardworking people want to see in our political system. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruralbob]
Thank you for considering. Your support means more than you know.
Showing up is paramount.
Best,
Bob Lorinser

subject: Misinformation & the 2024 election
body:
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1552%2E120351%2EuHUUtq)
Peter — what do Fox News, RFK Jr., Donald Trump, and Tucker Carlson have in common?
**All are powerful and dangerous engines of misinformation, disseminating an endless stream of conspiracy theories and lies — completely untethered from reality.**
As the 2024 election approaches, America is facing a growing information crisis with the potential to threaten our democracy.
**[We'll explain more in a moment, but if you're short on time, can you help us fight misinformation by pitching in $5 today to expand our reporting's reach?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230912?refcode=&amount=5&refcode2=1552_120351_uHUUtq&akid=1552%2E120351%2EuHUUtq)
In a bid to drive ratings and profits, Fox News and its hosts have spent their time recycling the same debunked conspiracy theories about the Biden “crime family,” and pushing the same disinformation campaigns surrounding Donald Trump’s four pending criminal trials. More recently, Fox has been driving an impeachment inquiry into President Biden _without any evidence_ , and hosting the likes of Robert F. Kennedy Jr. — a known conspiracy theorist who has credited Fox with “keeping his campaign afloat.”
Meanwhile, bad actors like Tucker Carlson and Donald Trump continue to propagate misinformation freely, inflaming the anger and mistrust that led to the violent insurrection on January 6th.
_Peter, it's no wonder why more than 185 million Americans don't trust the news._
**We've seen just how dangerous our political environment can become when misinformation is allowed to spread unchecked. The good news is that COURIER's team of committed journalists is dedicated to correcting the record in real time.[Will you help power this important work by chipping in?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230912?refcode=&amount=5&refcode2=1552_120351_uHUUtq&akid=1552%2E120351%2EuHUUtq)
At COURIER, we’re committed to debunking misinformation and telling the truth about the stories and issues that matter most in the communities we serve in nine battleground states (and growing!).
Our research-backed approach shows that the best way to stop the spread of bad information is by making good information freely available in the online spaces where misinformation spreads.
With next year’s election only a year away, COURIER is mobilizing to expand our journalism’s reach to confront right-wing propaganda head-on, reclaim our voices in our communities, and strengthen our democracy. Folks like you, Peter, make this possible.
**[If you're ready to fight back against dangerous lies and disinformation at its source, can you make a $5 contribution today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230912?refcode=&amount=5&refcode2=1552_120351_uHUUtq&akid=1552%2E120351%2EuHUUtq)

name: Shift WA
subject: Inslee’s 4th term as Governor?
body:
Bob Ferguson is running to continue the far-Left policies of what amounts to Jay Inslee's fourth term as governor. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62242865:Wsxq0ODNF:m:1:2610672541:017467680DE567870FB6799393AC49AB:r "Shift Washington")
---
| Friends,

Attorney General Bob Ferguson is currently celebrating an endorsement from Governor Jay Inslee. This might not come as a surprise given that so far Ferguson is running essentially a campaign for Inslee's fourth term as governor. It's clear that the current AG will continue Inslee's extreme environmental and tax-raising policies in Olympia if voters give him the chance.

This week, candidate Ferguson shared a tweet featuring a quote from Governor Inslee that he will "hold powerful interests accountable and defend our core freedoms." State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

body:
Tears & Laughs Breakout In Tulsa Last night at Sheridan.Church was AMAZING! The presence of God hit night two of IGNITE 2023 in a tangible way. Eva
| | |
---
## Tears & Laughs Breakout In Tulsa
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.600.1.a9417a3c47b51460ce70c8307a96c2be)
---
Last night at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.601.1.4dd0d9b34fef7042c57aeb42aed2081b) was **AMAZING**!
The presence of God hit night two of [IGNITE 2023](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.602.1.18dcb02d1221560ce7f3468049237abb) in a tangible way.
Evangelist **David Ring** (born w/cerebral palsy) preached a sermon that produced _tears_ and _laughs_ simultaneously.
I personally was impacted in a way that is hard to describe.
ICYMI, watch IGNITE Pt. 2 here: [https://www.youtube.com/live/Gttp93EzeQg?si=kTufmKAX5Pv_Jr53](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.603.1.253dcefb2133e52604183a9590d3fdf7)
I want to **HIGHLY** encourage you to join me tonight at 7pm for IGNITE Pt. 3 w/**Dr. Randy Caldwell**.
Invite a friend to come with you and let's seek the face of God together!
Address: 7901 E 41st St Tulsa, OK
| | [ IGNITE 2023 Pt. 2 - David Ring ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.604.1.6e888958db7a6c72bd1e939ec1fd1ee3)
---
---
## Lara Trump & Kash Patel @Sheridan.Church
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.605.1.23f5a525eb3cbb03fd7b971a6c6a7957)
---
This week was the kickoff to [IGNITE 2023](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.606.1.9bb330e75f01f49b290fe8640beff83c) at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.607.1.2a309bb42f8b911ff5a1f30cb9128690) in Tulsa, OK.
We were honored to have **State Superintendent Ryan Walters** , **Tulsa County Sheriff Vic Regalado** and **Tulsa City Councilor Jayme Fowler** share a few remarks about what is happening locally.
We also heard from **Kash Patel** & **Lara Trump** about what is taking place throughout our country.
One of the highlights was when **Lara Trump** called her _father-in-law_ , **President Donald Trump**!
**President Trump** spoke to the audience for several minutes and the atmosphere was electric.
ICYMI, watch Night 1 here: [https://rumble.com/v3ge5k3-lara-trump-and-kash-patel-live-from-tulsarusalem.html](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.608.1.d18fee1db49743d051cd8fb056761435)
| | [ Watch: Lara Trump & Kash Patel LIVE ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.609.1.b45bf2c1d61c6a79bcbd5e8b5c330a61)
---
---
## Special Guest Speaker Coming To Sheridan In October
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.610.1.0d4325c5592c34027a159d0b9ee3df6d)
---
I have always been a _major_ sports fan.
Recently, I watched a documentary on the great **New York Mets** baseball player **Darryl Strawberry**.
I knew of **Darryl Strawberry's** tremendous career and his unfortunate downfall to drugs later in his career.
What I did not know was how God restored him and called Darryl to the ministry.
Shortly after learning this, I began following **Darryl Strawberry** and his ministry and have been amazed at the preacher he is.
This is why I am excited to invite you to join me at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1455837.611.1.089db339365b2fd62a12a52592d9412a) Tulsa on **Sunday, October 8** to hear **Darryl Strawberry** preach the Gospel!
Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer

Let's be honest, very few people want to wear hearing aids. Although there have been huge breakthroughs in technology, most people don't use them simply because they are still big and ugly. However, Dr. Marco Vietor and Paul Crusius wanted to change this perception with **a revolutionary device developed with top German hearing aid engineers** formerly from Siemens. After many years of research and development, this team of engineers came up with a game-changing hearing aid that's completely crushing the market with powerful German technology.

**The result:** A hearing device that packs cutting-edge technology in a design so small, it completely disappears inside the ear. It's called the Horizon Mini by hear.com.

name: Andy Kim
subject: The oath we take.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
Every member of Congress must take an oath of office before they serve. Each time I've recited the oath, I've been honored and awed at the responsibility it represents, at the history behind it, and at the trust the people of New Jersey have put in me. I swore I'd never let them down.

When members of Congress take the oath of office, we promise to support and defend the United States Constitution and the core values of our democracy. It is a solemn commitment to prioritize the good of our nation over party affiliation or personal ambition.

Extremist House Republicans have broken that promise with an agenda not focused on life, liberty, or the pursuit of happiness but instead on ruthlessness, spite, and divisiveness :

Passing hateful legislation targeting the LGBTQ+ community.

Voting to restrict women's access to life-saving reproductive health care .

Demanding cuts to SNAP food assistance.

Conducting baseless investigations that waste taxpayer time and money.

Now, they're threatening to single-handedly shut down the government, which will cut off critical services for millions of working families, seniors, children, and veterans.

Congress should work for the people who elected us. We need to be spending our time on things that matter – like lowering costs for working families, making health care more accessible for everyone, investing more in a clean energy future, and getting dark money out of politics. Instead, Kevin McCarthy has repeatedly caved to the most extreme members of his caucus. Those extreme Republicans are now threatening to hold our government hostage. McCarthy is choosing his job security as Speaker over the needs of Americans.

It's time we had leaders who take their oath of office seriously and put you first.

More soon,

Andy

\-----------------------------------------------

Fellow Conservative,

My name is Tim Sheehy - I’m a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot.

I’ll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I’m answering the call again. | | Friend, Right now, the United Auto Workers (UAW) union is fighting against three corporate titans for better labor standards, and the climate movement is ready to stand with them. **A fair transition to a clean energy future means building an economy that supports workers and communities.**

But the Big Three automakers—GM, Ford, and Stellantis—want to drive a false narrative that says supporting clean cars is not in line with worker protections. This is just not true.

That's why **we need your help spreading the word that the climate movement supports a clean energy transition that benefits workers.******
---
| The deployment of clean vehicles is inseparable from justice for the workers building them. I stand with United Auto Workers and believe everyone must benefit from the transition to a clean energy future. Read more and spread the message [ ](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5016?t=4&akid=13662%2E53494%2EXGty0e) | Share via:| [ ](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5017?t=5&akid=13662%2E53494%2EXGty0e) | [ ](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5018?t=6&akid=13662%2E53494%2EXGty0e) | [ ](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/5019?t=7&akid=13662%2E53494%2EXGty0e)
---|---|---|---
Automakers must get the message that competing in the new economy means investing in their workers to build skill, trust, and power—not hoarding the benefits of a clean vehicle boom. **A viable climate future is one in which prosperity is broadly shared.** President Biden has already backed UAW's position and indicated that he’s ready to fight for workers. **Now it's on us to amplify the message that the deployment of clean vehicles is inseparable from justice for the workers building them.**

clean_body: This is what a fair transition looks like | | | | | | | Friend, Right now, the United Auto Workers (UAW) union is fighting against three corporate titans for better labor standards, and the climate movement is ready to stand with them. A fair transition to a clean energy future means building an economy that supports workers and communities. But the Big Three automakers—GM, Ford, and Stellantis—want to drive a false narrative that says supporting clean cars is not in line with worker protections. This is just not true. That's why we need your help spreading the word that the climate movement supports a clean energy transition that benefits workers.** | The deployment of clean vehicles is inseparable from justice for the workers building them. I stand with United Auto Workers and believe everyone must benefit from the transition to a clean energy future. Read more and spread the message | Share via:| | | ---|---|---|--- Automakers must get the message that competing in the new economy means investing in their workers to build skill, trust, and power—not hoarding the benefits of a clean vehicle boom. A viable climate future is one in which prosperity is broadly shared. President Biden has already backed UAW's position and indicated that he’s ready to fight for workers. Now it's on us to amplify the message that the deployment of clean vehicles is inseparable from justice for the workers building them. Please, just hear me out:

| |
---
| | | Friend, Speaker of the House Kevin McCarthy here. Please, just hear me out:
_**Do you have a single dollar to spare?**_
Allow me to explain: While asking for a dollar might seem silly, I rely on donations from folks like you here and there to fuel our efforts and protect our House Majority.
**_[Send $1>>](https://secure.winred.com/kevin-mccarthy/one-dollar/?recurring=true&utm_campaign=20230912_WG-AUN2.103067_t1386599-793&ex_tid=20230912_WG-AUN2.103067_t1386599-793&utm_content=tv-au-20230912&xunv=tv-au-20230912 "Send $1 >>")_**
Nancy Pelosi, Hakeem Jeffries, and the rest of the Democrats have war chests filled to the brim with cash from wealthy mega-donors and Hollywood elites.**Folks like you are truly the backbone of this campaign. **

State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

**In Case You Missed It:**
**Chris Christie Takes No Prisoners at “No B.S. BBQ” in Rye**
_“But talking with voters after his remarks, it wasn’t Christie’s handling of the issues or his sharp attacks against fellow candidates that stood out to them. They just liked Christie, the person.”_
[NH Journal](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=834947d77c&e=d0a9afa930)
Mitchell Scacchi
September 11, 2023
“Former New Jersey Gov. Chris Christie was the latest presidential candidate to grace the stage at the ‘No B.S. BBQ’ hosted by former U.S. Sen. and Ambassador Scott Brown and his wife Gail Huff Brown Monday night. And he made it clear he wasn’t there to make nice with former President Donald Trump or the GOP candidates who Christie believes are empowering him.
“I will never raise my hand that it’s okay that a convicted felon can be president,’ Christie said at one point. At another, he mocked entrepreneur Vivek Ramaswamy as a ‘shallow’ 38-year-old.
“But talking with voters after his remarks, it wasn’t Christie’s handling of the issues or his sharp attacks against fellow candidates that stood out to them. They just liked Christie, the person.
“He’s a really high-quality guy,’ said Jim Burns of New Castle, N.H.
“I’ve always been a fan of his,’ John Dye of Portsmouth, N.H., told NHJournal. ‘When he was the governor [of New Jersey], he was just no-nonsense, tells it like it is, pisses people off, and shakes it up, so I’m hoping he shakes it up in this election.’
“This is the third time I’ve been to a Chris Christie townhall,’ said Nancy Ryan of Lee, N.H. ‘I find him quite personable, very honest in his answers. I’ve not made a decision about who I’m going to support in 2024— and I’m a registered Democrat — and so if I were advising a friend, I would say look very, very closely at Governor Christie to my Republican friends.”
“Christie only spent a few minutes delivering a stump speech before he began taking questions. ...
“Christie has been polling similarly to DeSantis and Ramaswamy, and he just received some of his best numbers nationally. In a Rasmussen Reports poll released last week, Christie was tied with DeSantis for second place at nine percent, behind the former president’s 45 percent.
“The former governor of New Jersey has seen some of his best polling in New Hampshire. ...
“It’s no secret that Christie’s campaign hinges on success in New Hampshire. And his main pitch to Granite State voters Monday centered on two main points: ‘New Hampshire’s going to decide” and ‘We’ve got to start nominating people who can win again.’
“And the reason I believe New Hampshire can and will do it, is because I’ve seen you do it before,’ Christie told the room. ‘When everybody thinks they’ve got you figured out, you’re not.’ ...
“Nancy Ryan of Lee sees New Hampshire as Christie’s best shot, too. ‘I think he’s doing a smart thing to focus on New Hampshire,’ she told NHJournal. ‘I think he can get a real footing here, maybe gain some ground.’ ...
“Yet, John Dye of Portsmouth thinks Christie has a shot to take down both Trump and Biden. ‘I think so, I think so.... It’s still early.’ ...”

They just liked Christie, the person.” Mitchell Scacchi September 11, 2023 “Former New Jersey Gov. Chris Christie was the latest presidential candidate to grace the stage at the ‘No B.S. BBQ’ hosted by former U.S. Sen. and Ambassador Scott Brown and his wife Gail Huff Brown Monday night. And he made it clear he wasn’t there to make nice with former President Donald Trump or the GOP candidates who Christie believes are empowering him. “I will never raise my hand that it’s okay that a convicted felon can be president,’ Christie said at one point. At another, he mocked entrepreneur Vivek Ramaswamy as a ‘shallow’ 38-year-old. “But talking with voters after his remarks, it wasn’t Christie’s handling of the issues or his sharp attacks against fellow candidates that stood out to them. They just liked Christie, the person. “He’s a really high-quality guy,’ said Jim Burns of New Castle, N.H. “I’ve always been a fan of his,’ John Dye of Portsmouth, N.H., told NHJournal. ‘When he was the governor [of New Jersey], he was just no-nonsense, tells it like it is, pisses people off, and shakes it up, so I’m hoping he shakes it up in this election.’ “This is the third time I’ve been to a Chris Christie townhall,’ said Nancy Ryan of Lee, N.H. ‘I find him quite personable, very honest in his answers. I’ve not made a decision about who I’m going to support in 2024— and I’m a registered Democrat — and so if I were advising a friend, I would say look very, very closely at Governor Christie to my Republican friends.” “Christie only spent a few minutes delivering a stump speech before he began taking questions. ... “Christie has been polling similarly to DeSantis and Ramaswamy, and he just received some of his best numbers nationally. In a Rasmussen Reports poll released last week, Christie was tied with DeSantis for second place at nine percent, behind the former president’s 45 percent. “The former governor of New Jersey has seen some of his best polling in New Hampshire. ... “It’s no secret that Christie’s campaign hinges on success in New Hampshire. body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: September 12, 2023
---
| Contact: Derek Dufresne derek@ascent-strategic.com; 202-809-6013
---
| More Granite State Leaders Continue to Line Up Behind Prescott in NH-01
---
| Exeter, NH \- Today, Russell Prescott announced another round of endorsements from Granite State leaders in his campaign for Congress in NH-01. As his strong grassroots support continues to grow, so does his fundraising, with the recent announcement of his campaign war chest surpassing $400,000.00 in his first fundraising quarter.
State Senator Dan Innis, Senate District 7, Former Senator for the Seacoast-based District 24, and Small Business Owner, Bradford "Russell Prescott has a legacy of being one of the best advocates for our Seacoast communities in Concord, which is why I know he will be equally as strong of a representative for all of NH-01 in Washington. The combination of his conservative track record coupled with his independent voice is exactly what we need to defeat Congressman Chris Pappas. Unifying our party early under the banner of a tested leader who has proven he can win tough races is critical to winning next November. I am proud to put my full support behind Russell Prescott for Congress."
Former State Senator for District 17 and Former State Representative John Reagan, Deerfield "New Hampshire's First District needs a leader who has the experience and track record to reflect the common sense conservative Live Free or Die values we pride ourselves on. That man is Russell Prescott. I know him, I trust him, and he has my full support in his campaign for Congress."
Former New Hampshire House Speaker Donna Sytek, Salem "I know that strong and effective leadership doesn't lend itself to on-the-job training. It is a skill you hone after years of learning the values of your community and effectively representing their interests. Russell Prescott has been so formidable at this that he has the record of being the only Republican to defeat Maggie Hassan for office not only once, but twice. That is the kind of person who can win a congressional seat in New Hampshire, which is exactly why I am happy to support Russell in NH-01."
Town Councilor, County Commissioner, and Former State Representative Brian Chirichiello, Derry "I've represented the great people of Derry in many different capacities, so I know what they are looking for in the representative they hope to send to Washington. They want a hardworking congressman who will keep their taxes low, build a better economy, and listen to their everyday concerns. One with experience, a steady temperament, and a record to stand on. That's Russell Prescott. He is the right person for the job, which is why he has my full support in his race for Congress in NH-01."
Additional new endorsements:
* Former State Representative Joanne Ward, Stratham

* Mayor George Hansel, Keene

* Marian Noronha, President and founder of Turbocam International, Barrington

* Ronnie Schlender, Queen City Community Leader, Manchester

* Bob Preston, Small Business Owner, Hampton

* Shane McKinney, Carroll County Republican Leader, Conway

* Mike Schidlovsky, Former President of the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce, Durham

* David Dube, Small Business Owner, Merrimack

* Jane Graham, Former Gubernatorial, Senatorial, and Congressional Staffer, Bedford

* John Galloway, Small Business Owner, Plaistow

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

Lowering prescription drug prices has always been one of my top priorities in Congress, Peter. Let me tell you why:

I was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes when I was sixteen years old. As a patient and as a doctor, I’ve seen firsthand how the price of prescription drugs has skyrocketed over the past twenty years – from $40 a vial to upwards of $300.

That’s why last year, I was proud to vote for the Inflation Reduction Act, which includes historic provisions allowing Medicare to negotiate lower drug prices. **And just last week, the Biden Administration announced the first ten drugs selected for Medicare price negotiation – including medication treating diabetes!**

Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, over 9 million Americans (and 100,000 Washington seniors) will save money when Medicare negotiates lower drug prices.

**But the bad news is that, no surprise, Big Pharma is still fighting back against our efforts to lower drug prices for seniors.** Pharmaceutical companies like Merck and AstraZeneca are even suing to block Medicare’s price negotiations. Given blockbuster profits, escalating prices, and spending on advertising and lobbying that outpaces spending on research, this can only be explained by corporate greed. Cutting-edge medicine will only help people if they can afford to buy it.

body:
I’ve fought for America overseas. Now I’m doing it in Missouri.

| |
---
| | | I’ve fought for America overseas. Now I’m doing it in Missouri. | | |
---
| | | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c22444%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cS9Q3xg6dUVhl456HuWG6w&sysid=1)
---

Friend,

I’m nothing to write home about. I didn’t graduate from a fancy Ivy League school. I didn’t come from a super wealthy family. I’m just a small-town guy from Missouri who chose to serve my country overseas.

I firmly believe in God’s guiding hand and I know His gracious protection was over me when I was in dangerous and uncertain circumstances fighting for the freedoms we hold dear.

I know my calling is to serve this country and protect it from enemies foreign and domestic.

And just like you, I’m fed up with the way the Democrats & Establishment politicians continually put the interests of Americans last.

_**That’s why I've just announced I’m running to be the next Governor of the great state of Missouri.**_

We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcb098af0-2bc8-46a6-acb8-9454845311cd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| | | | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T60916b67-c2be-48e0-a4c7-77c5944af894/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I thought my days of putting people on the ground were over when I left the NFL. Then January 6th happened. I was on the House floor when rioters breached the Capitol, and I remember hearing the glass break and the shouts coming closer. As they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son: “Whatever happens, I love you.” I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that. And while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues and our gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – hid in a supply closet. Ted Cruz’s false claims about the 2020 election helped incite the insurrection. That's Ted for you: All hat, no cattle. That day is one of many, many reasons I know Ted Cruz has got to go. People lost their lives, and our government came the closest it ever has to crumbling. His MAGA extremism is bad for Texas and our country, and it’s time to hold him accountable. name: Phil Kerpen
subject: ACTION ALERT: House votes this week to BLOCK California's internal combustion vehicle ban
body:
Patriot,
Rep. John Joyce from Pennsylvania has introduced H.R. 1435, the Preserving Choice for Vehicle Purchases Act, which would block California's proposed ban on internal combustion vehicles. The bill is scheduled for House floor consideration this week.
[Please click here now to demand Congress pass for H.R. 1435, the Preserving Choice for Vehicle Purchases Act.](http://mgmail.americanpatriotdaily.com/c/eJx00Dm2pCoYAODVaMhhkh8Cg3du3doHo2CBs1i6-ne6886_6HO9dAqIbH1PhOKdoJzjNvZGgLbacmqCDYGAdZhIsIIR8MQZ06aeYsqwIpQyDhQjgrjofimjPy_1-_PmijUc6-K3ZPW06GNL8-F0yjeyc2lzH49jadh_DX039H1s2n7Qv_Qfw97fIzfsRQJMOpfn8S48LLmNSuzTBOJ2a87VKcMq91eK1HTLGpdOXQo_kVHfHew5o1pVoQPstdxyCAG28t3VLa65Qo6-BHOfblvHOVg5gJCh-rvsSn08ubKFqEuRouMLNFT4FBv2-jxFTvsximUrI5j4wD7WOt37CszoIbalF7TrOGDZbr1brpRz2gU0HA9Fp_y34-i_aMdnmjEiTC2o5nLGDdX82fGE4rRIAkg6M2sUgDuGyHiy_wMAAP__wmSQ5w)
The automobile market is national and the global climate change issue is literally global. California's authority derives from a waiver the Biden administration granted them to set their own vehicle’s standards – despite the obvious adverse effect on interstate commerce.
H.R. 1435 amends federal law to prohibit the use of a Clean Air Act waiver to impose an internal combustion vehicle ban. This is critical for all Americans because the waiver allows California to set de facto standards for the whole country by forcing manufacturers to shift their production to electric vehicles.
Congressman Joyce is right to say, "California regulators shouldn't have the power to determine what vehicles are sold to families in Pennsylvania." That goes for every other state too.
[Please click here now to demand Congress pass for H.R. 1435, the Preserving Choice for Vehicle Purchases Act.](http://mgmail.americanpatriotdaily.com/c/eJx00DmWpCAYAODTaMiDH2QJDOZ1dd0DAQuUxZVWTz9vJu_8iz7bS6sEka3rCVes48AYbn2vuO64dE5jQYxWFoCJzoySUAfGaWhDDxgoVgSAMgEYEcR49w0Uvl7q--vNFG0Y1sltwei86GML5bA6xBuZktrY--NYGvqngXcD72PTZka_6X-Gvq8jNvRFRpF1TM_j7PjQYDeQ2IUs-G3XGKvNKYn1Hsy41Yk4DX4tYq7R-HWI5UqflIqewgB5v8RasfjZ61rpVnLw9xncwp9Zl0UlU1UewiCvFY-m1NvNszoXNk1PnfOnyw1wF3xDX_OTZN6PiS9bmsTgH7FPteZ7XwUd9Me3qefQdUxg2W69XX5CjGHnomH4k3SI_zuO_kI7PkPBiFC1oBrT6TdU47zjjHxeJBFI2qFoNApmKSLTSf8GAAD__2qFlAU)

clean_body: Patriot, Rep. John Joyce from Pennsylvania has introduced H.R. 1435, the Preserving Choice for Vehicle Purchases Act, which would block California's proposed ban on internal combustion vehicles. The bill is scheduled for House floor consideration this week. The automobile market is national and the global climate change issue is literally global. California's authority derives from a waiver the Biden administration granted them to set their own vehicle’s standards – despite the obvious adverse effect on interstate commerce. H.R. 1435 amends federal law to prohibit the use of a Clean Air Act waiver to impose an internal combustion vehicle ban. This is critical for all Americans because the waiver allows California to set de facto standards for the whole country by forcing manufacturers to shift their production to electric vehicles. Congressman Joyce is right to say, "California regulators shouldn't have the power to determine what vehicles are sold to families in Pennsylvania." That goes for every other state too. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

In service, Tom Cotton \----------------------------------------------- Peter, My name is Tim Sheehy - I’m a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot. I’ll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I’m answering the call again. America needs true conservative leaders who will set-up and serve our GREAT nation. My next mission is to defeat Liberal Democrat Senator Jon Tester and end his near quarter century political career. You may not know me yet, although I hope to change that today, but you do know what I stand for as a Navy SEAL; I’ve fought for you, for our freedoms and liberties, to protect and defend our nation from those who wish to do us harm on their own soil. Career politicians like Montana Democrat Senator Jon Tester, who has been in elected office for nearly 25 years, are not getting the job done. My friend Sen. Tom Cotton’s introduction at the top of this email comes because he believes that I’m the one Republican in Montana who can send Jon Tester out to pasture once and for all. Here is why this email is important: When I beat Jon Tester next November, it will flip the Senate Republican. Sen. Cotton and I need your help to get the job done. Peter, as a Navy SEAL, I fought and bled for this country – and considering our crippling debt, open borders, and woke culture - I’m prepared to sacrifice even more of myself for the betterment of all Americans. We need strong leaders who will solve problems and put Montana - and America - FIRST. When I joined the Navy, I made a commitment not only to myself, but to my country. Our country. Those of you reading this today who served in the Armed Forces will know that the commitment we made to America when we joined up isn’t just for four, six, or even 20 years – it’s lifelong. During my time as a Navy SEAL, I was deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific – I’ve been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces. But, running to be Montana’s next U.S. Senator will be the toughest mission yet. Just look at where are as a nation. Since Joe Biden took office our once strong economy is no longer what it once was as we experience skyrocketing inflation, our borders are more porous than ever before, and the woke culture of the Left is tearing apart the very fabric of our society. I’ve been training for this moment my entire life, Peter. To accomplish this mission, it’s going to take all of America working together as a TEAM. Our adversary is well-armed and has well insulated himself against attacks over his three-term career in D.C. That’s why I’m going to be counting on having the best possible team around me to successfully navigate the terrain. Hooyah, Tim Sheehy Former Navy SEAL Republican for U.S. Senate P.S. | |
# Party of the Constitution
---
**ALEX NEWMAN** , an award-winning international journalist, has confirmed his attendance at the Mackinac Leadership Conference.
The **NEW MIGOP** , which is led by the grassroots, is committed to making this conference the best one yet. We have an impressive lineup of speakers, including JIM CAVIEZEL, KARI LAKE, DINESH D'SOUZA, ZUBY, and now award-winning journalist ALEX NEWMAN. We are confident that the upcoming Mackinac Republican Leadership Conference will be unforgettable.
Alex Newman is a multi-talented professional who strives to honor God in all aspects of his work, including journalism, education, writing, speaking, investing, and consulting.
In addition to being president of Liberty Sentinel Media, Inc., he has written for numerous publications in the United States and internationally.
Throughout his career as a journalist, Alex has had the opportunity to interview numerous fascinating individuals, including current and former heads of state, members of Congress, and royalty. His work has been recognized with numerous awards and has been featured in various media outlets such as Drudge, Breitbart, Fox News, CNN, and the Washington Post.
Alex has written and collaborated on numerous books, including a notable work titled "Crimes of the Educators". This book was co-authored with renowned Dr. Samuel Blumenfeld and sheds light on the issues with government schools. It was published by WND Books and received endorsements from various conservative leaders, such as Phyllis Schlafly and Ron Paul.
Alex collaborated with renowned investigative journalists like Cliff Kincaid, Trevor Loudon, Joel Gilbert, and others to write an exposé on Obama. He also authored a book that sheds light on the Deep State and co-wrote another book that exposed the World Federalist movement.
For additional details about our Mackinac Island Conference, please [click here](https://migop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bcd38e28909007274d8cce33&id=2cfe7d20b0&e=a2af77507c).

We cannot wait to see you at this historic conference.

body:
Tears & Laughs Breakout In Tulsa Last night at Sheridan.Church was AMAZING! The presence of God hit night two of IGNITE 2023 in a tangible way. Eva
| | |
---
## Tears & Laughs Breakout In Tulsa
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.623.1.23e572ce3bbe098bd5a1ab438db14544)
---
Last night at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.624.1.9ab4135decebbb3cfbf1e9f186149d29) was **AMAZING**!
The presence of God hit night two of [IGNITE 2023](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.625.1.a04a742df104bdc241901b5c4a183e87) in a tangible way.
Evangelist **David Ring** (born w/cerebral palsy) preached a sermon that produced _tears_ and _laughs_ simultaneously.
I personally was impacted in a way that is hard to describe.
ICYMI, watch IGNITE Pt. 2 here: [https://www.youtube.com/live/Gttp93EzeQg?si=kTufmKAX5Pv_Jr53](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.626.1.e979c0be2f368b6f203c5aea0596734f)
I want to **HIGHLY** encourage you to join me tonight at 7pm for IGNITE Pt. 3 w/**Dr. Randy Caldwell**.
Invite a friend to come with you and let's seek the face of God together!
Address: 7901 E 41st St Tulsa, OK
| | [ IGNITE 2023 Pt. 2 - David Ring ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.627.1.b572884ee5f34aa63f16765a1499dec2)
---
---
## Lara Trump & Kash Patel @Sheridan.Church
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.628.1.995ff65096db2af14cf106093f01694f)
---
This week was the kickoff to [IGNITE 2023](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.629.1.2d9ae3dd23e5244b79d17363643bf4d5) at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.630.1.e45ceb6a091ea0b23bf82edc8201cea8) in Tulsa, OK.
We were honored to have **State Superintendent Ryan Walters** , **Tulsa County Sheriff Vic Regalado** and **Tulsa City Councilor Jayme Fowler** share a few remarks about what is happening locally.
We also heard from **Kash Patel** & **Lara Trump** about what is taking place throughout our country.
One of the highlights was when **Lara Trump** called her _father-in-law_ , **President Donald Trump**!
**President Trump** spoke to the audience for several minutes and the atmosphere was electric.
ICYMI, watch Night 1 here: [https://rumble.com/v3ge5k3-lara-trump-and-kash-patel-live-from-tulsarusalem.html](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.631.1.fc1a2a5f867c1fc470f8acec0795c510)
| | [ Watch: Lara Trump & Kash Patel LIVE ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.632.1.40c47ef531a34f5a04bf862a9e6a87bf)
---
---
## Special Guest Speaker Coming To Sheridan In October
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.633.1.67ed7668f83256f8fd0e00465e81cc1b)
---
I have always been a _major_ sports fan.
Recently, I watched a documentary on the great **New York Mets** baseball player **Darryl Strawberry**.
I knew of **Darryl Strawberry's** tremendous career and his unfortunate downfall to drugs later in his career.
What I did not know was how God restored him and called Darryl to the ministry.
Shortly after learning this, I began following **Darryl Strawberry** and his ministry and have been amazed at the preacher he is.
This is why I am excited to invite you to join me at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=1600437.634.1.62b93f4ee254cd6497a2b2b43f5552f1) Tulsa on **Sunday, October 8** to hear **Darryl Strawberry** preach the Gospel!
Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer

body:
#
**Peter, I'm beyond excited to support Summer Lee as she launches her campaign for re-election!**
Summer made history last year when she became the first Black Congresswoman elected in Pennsylvania and beat out millions of dollars in corporate PAC spending against her. But she didn't let it slow her down one bit — she got to Washington and she's been fighting for working class people day and night since taking office in January. Now it's time to ensure she keeps that seat for the people of Western PA.
**[Before I go any further about why we need more progressive champions like Summer in the House, can you split a $3 donation between our campaigns to make sure Summer can continue to fight for working families for a second term?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/45527?refcode=em20230912-2910&t=1&akid=2910%2E420207%2EHOCFLm)**
**[Donate ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/45527?refcode=em20230912-2910&t=20&akid=2910%2E420207%2EHOCFLm)**
**So why am I supporting Summer?**
As a true advocate for the people, **Summer Lee has always taken on big fights with greedy corporations who put profits over the lives of people** , and even led the call for accountability for Norfolk Southern after the East Palestine Train Derailment.
Summer has also introduced three crucial bills in her short time in office — the Hazard Pay for Health Care Workers Act, the Equality in our Laws Act, and the Bipartisan Abandoned Well Remediation Act — which passed through the Science, Space, and Technology committee with a unanimous, bipartisan vote. She even co-led over a dozen bills, including legislation to make sure billionaires pay their fair share in taxes**.**
**And this is all in just the 9 months since she took office. Imagine what we can accomplish together with another term and a Democratic majority!**
We're already seeing right-wing billionaire-backed corporate Super PAC's pour money into stopping our movement for true multiracial democracy and working class families in 2024, but we can't let them win. We've beat them before — let's do it again.
**[Peter, support our movement for the people by splitting a $3 donation to Summer Lee and our campaign today.](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/45527?refcode=em20230912-2910&t=21&akid=2910%2E420207%2EHOCFLm)**
Putting the people first,
Pramila Jayapal

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

| Hey Peter, it's Max.

Last week, a school district right here in Orange County approved a policy backed by concerned parents that requires school administrators to notify parents if their children begin identifying as a different gender.

They took a lot of heat for it ... _But I want you to know that I applaud these parents and urge more school districts to adopt similar measures._

It's simple: schools need more communication with parents, not less. **_Schools shouldn't be allowed to keep secrets about kids from their parents._**

**I believe that when it comes to kids, we need a government that puts parents - not bureaucrats - first. **I'm running for Congress to be a vocal advocate for Parents' Rights in their children's education.

This won't be an easy fight. The Left will do whatever they can to keep the government bureaucrats in charge. The good news is that a recent poll showed a majority of voters support Parents' Rights. _But I need to know ... do YOU?_
[**_Can you let me know if we're standing in this fight for Parents' Rights together?_**](https://maxforoc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0d5d4fbfb4ace920581f6c90d&id=b5f265c501&e=86e91e802d)
