That's why I plan to go to Washington as an unapologetic advocate for parents rights and fixing the federal government's broken approach to education ... [**_but I need to know if you'll be with me on this._**](https://maxforoc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0d5d4fbfb4ace920581f6c90d&id=65bc79252c&e=86e91e802d)

name: Gene Karpinski, LCV
subject: Your Impact and the Power of the Conservation Voters Movement
body:
Recent victories in states nationwide, with your help |
---

** **
|
There are many things that make LCV unique in the environmental movement, one of which is our ability to quickly mobilize the public in response to rapidly-changing policy and advocacy needs. This has been critical to our success in recent years, helping us hold elected leaders accountable to advance and defend strong policies on climate, clean energy, democracy, and more._****_

**Right now, there are HUGE victories being won at the state level that are only possible because of the support of our movement** -- including you, Peter. We want you to know exactly how much your support matters.

Thanks to LCV members, we are able to support and amplify the work of our **30+ state affiliates in the Conservation Voters Movement (CVM)** by facilitating close collaboration and sharing of expertise and resources across our national network movement.
_Here are three state-level victories in recent weeks that illustrate the power of the CVM:_

## MAINE: Coalition Yields Critical Offshore Wind Commitment
Thanks to recently passed legislation, Maine is committing to develop **three gigawatts of offshore wind by 2024 -- enough power to eventually provide for nearly half of the state's energy needs** while advancing its goal of 100 percent clean energy by 2040. This latest advance for offshore wind is the result of a winning coalition of labor and environmental groups and provides a national model for the clean energy transition.

**LCV 's partnership with [Maine Conservation Voters (MCV)](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/~NwYfDkqjrFy/NmN2UjNNa1d1T1BOUDBYQVpydWdBSm1UZndOdzR0ZW1DSTd1NCt3cWpUZ1dLRWhHN0JmTTVITFpIeVBJRHg3bzgwdzRaUkRRRmtCcjJjK1lwNHlPS1o2bjB5cFlscXRLUWZTSmpGdEU5L2M9S0/) played a key role in enabling this victory.** To get this bill across the finish line, MCV ran an extensive digital ad campaign, held regular public education virtual events, drove turnout to hearings and lobby days, garnered over a thousand constituent messages to decision-makers, and built powerful relationships with labor partners. [Read more about Maine's offshore wind legislation.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/Pwb7C38wgAMW/NmN2UjNNa1d1T1BOUDBYQVpydWdBSm1UZndOdzR0ZW1DSTd1NCt3cWpUZ1dLRWhHN0JmTTVITFpIeVBJRHg3bzgwdzRaUkRRRmtCcjJjK1lwNHlPS1o2bjB5cFlscXRLUWZTSmpGdEU5L2M9S0/)
## MONTANA: Youth Win Historic Climate Lawsuit
[A Montana judge recently sided with youth activists](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/6Lg6B~WGe7Q8/NmN2UjNNa1d1T1BOUDBYQVpydWdBSm1UZndOdzR0ZW1DSTd1NCt3cWpUZ1dLRWhHN0JmTTVITFpIeVBJRHg3bzgwdzRaUkRRRmtCcjJjK1lwNHlPS1o2bjB5cFlscXRLUWZTSmpGdEU5L2M9S0/) and ruled that **a stable climate falls under the right to a "clean and healthful environment" as guaranteed in the state's constitution.** The youth plaintiffs, ranging in age from 5 to 22, sued the state over legislation that prevents state agencies from considering climate impacts when permitting fossil fuel development. This is an outstanding example of the importance of courts in addressing climate change and adds to the body of related legal decisions worldwide.

Our Montana state affiliate played an active role in the public education campaign on this critical issue. [Read more about the Montana court decision.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/j9y2f_Zrg8F_/NmN2UjNNa1d1T1BOUDBYQVpydWdBSm1UZndOdzR0ZW1DSTd1NCt3cWpUZ1dLRWhHN0JmTTVITFpIeVBJRHg3bzgwdzRaUkRRRmtCcjJjK1lwNHlPS1o2bjB5cFlscXRLUWZTSmpGdEU5L2M9S0/)
## OHIO: Voters Defeat Issue 1
**Issue 1 was an Ohio ballot initiative that would have taken power away from Ohioans** by increasing the proportion of votes required to amend the state's constitution from 50 to 60 percent and making it much harder to obtain the signatures needed to introduce future ballot measures. In August, voters defeated Issue 1 by roughly 57% to 43%. This victory in Ohio has implications for other potential future state ballot initiatives related to gerrymandering, voting rights, reproductive rights, the minimum wage, and the environment.

**The[Ohio Environmental Council Action Fund](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/7RYwsNKY09c-/NmN2UjNNa1d1T1BOUDBYQVpydWdBSm1UZndOdzR0ZW1DSTd1NCt3cWpUZ1dLRWhHN0JmTTVITFpIeVBJRHg3bzgwdzRaUkRRRmtCcjJjK1lwNHlPS1o2bjB5cFlscXRLUWZTSmpGdEU5L2M9S0/) ran a large campaign to help defeat Issue 1,** which included voter registration and get-out-the-vote efforts, print and digital outreach, rallies in major cities, a high-profile event with Ohio House Minority Leader Allison Russo, as well as digital and radio ads that yielded more than half a million impressions. [Read more about the stakes of defeating Issue 1.](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/ebDKc9Ak~mME/NmN2UjNNa1d1T1BOUDBYQVpydWdBSm1UZndOdzR0ZW1DSTd1NCt3cWpUZ1dLRWhHN0JmTTVITFpIeVBJRHg3bzgwdzRaUkRRRmtCcjJjK1lwNHlPS1o2bjB5cFlscXRLUWZTSmpGdEU5L2M9S0/)
**When _YOU_ support LCV, it has a multiplier effect across the country.** As states make more progress on climate action and democracy issues, their examples influence what happens in cities, other states, and Washington, D.C. That's why LCV invests year after year in grants, training, support, and coalition-building opportunities for our state affiliates that grow the long-term power of our movement.

You're making a real difference, Peter. I'm grateful for your support and for the opportunity to share in these important victories with you.

Onward,

Gene Karpinski
President
League of Conservation Voters |

My message to the GOP if they want to launch a sham impeachment inquiry is... go on, DO IT.
#
Hey Derek, it looks like the House GOP is going to launch an impeachment inquiry into the President.
_OMG, I'm devastated. I can't believe it. It's over!!_ 😂😂😂
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230912-1?refcode=em20230912-1&refcode2=8556_434096_L-yDKd&akid=8556%2E434096%2EL-yDKd)
**My message to the GOP if they want to launch a sham impeachment inquiry is... go on, DO IT. It's a political loser and they probably can't even find the votes.**
Meanwhile, I'll just be over here staying focused on the important work that matters for PA families. Like helping organic farms + agriculture with the _Streamlining Organic Research Act_. Supporting auto workers in their fight for a fair contract from the Big 3 automakers. And confirming diverse, qualified, impressive judges and administration appointees for roles throughout the government that make a difference in people's lives.
**[These are the sorts of priorities I know you gave me your support to fight for. If you're able to, consider chipping in any amount so I can keep up this important work in the Senate.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20230912-1?refcode=em20230912-1-8556&refcode2=8556_434096_L-yDKd&akid=8556%2E434096%2EL-yDKd)**

The Republican party across the country is hellbent on passing regressive legislation, from restricting access to abortion to attacking migrants at the border. As we go back into session today, I’m focused on fighting back. As a senior member of the Ways and Means Committee , I’m working to strengthen Social Security and ensure healthcare affordability. I’m working to advance commonsense, lifesaving solutions to our nation’s gun violence. This year, I was proud to co-sponsor the Recognizing Gun Violence as a Public Health Emergency Act. My work is far from over. I need your help to gather the resources to make progress on these and other crucial issues. = | = Anything you can give goes a long way. | Peter,
I can’t wait to speak with fellow patriots in Beatty and Tonopah today on the second stop of my Nevada speaking tour! I’ll be hosting events in each city, so check out the _tour schedule below_ and come join us!

In each city, I will be sharing with Nevadans my detailed plan to **fix the economy** , **strengthen national defense**, and restore **U.S energy independence**! Undoing the disastrous policies of our far-left government will take a strong leader willing to fight for Nevada, and I’m coming to show our people that **_I am here to fight for you!_**

This isn’t my first tour, as a Senior USAF Officer, I've been able to mobilize thousands under my command to fight for our country, and **I will do the same for Nevada**. Our state has been harmed by weak leadership for far too long, now we must unite together, and fight back for our people.

So come out and join the cause, as we come together to **Flip Nevada Red!!**

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Peter, I have a devastating update to share: **Public libraries across the country are on the verge of _shutting down_ because they contain titles that their local governments consider "inappropriate."**
Some of these books include incredibly important reads, such as "The Handmaid's Tale"__ and "Sweet Justice _." _Other books seem to be banned for no reason other than pure bigotry, such as "And Tango Makes Three _," _a children's book that features two male penguin fathers.
Peter, you can always count on me to fight for equality and progress – but the fight for our libraries is _personal_ to me.
You see, I've always loved to read. As a kid, I spent my summers in the library, where I could escape the oppressive heat of Brooklyn and instead spend hours wandering through stacks of well-worn books until I found exactly the right one. It was in these books that I learned about the fight for progress and began to see myself as someone capable of creating lasting change.
**I am the woman I am today because of the books I've read along the way – but tragically, far-right lawmakers across the nation have banned the same books that changed the trajectory of my life and so many others'. | | Peter, Across the country and in California's 30th, rising prices have been top of mind for many people. Thankfully, we are seeing action to get costs under control. **Last month, President Biden announced the first set of prescription drugs that will be eligible for price negotiations with Medicare under the Inflation Reduction Act.** Americans pay more for prescription drugs than any other major economy in the world, with Big Pharma gouging consumers in need of life-saving medicine. **But thanks to the IRA, Medicare will be able to negotiate better prices for prescriptions, including drugs that treat diabetes, heart failure, and even certain types of cancer.** High prescription drug costs have placed an unnecessary burden on the people who need care the most. Around 3 in 10 Americans have chosen to _go without their prescriptions because of high costs_ , putting their health at risk in the process. The IRA tackles these issues head-on, from capping the price of insulin at $35 to these price negotiations, giving people life-saving medication and much needed relief for their pocketbooks. **But this work cannot end here.** **The Inflation Reduction Act was a great start, but Congress must step up more to help people make ends meet. In Congress, I will push us forward by:**
1. Voting for a minimum wage that matches the basic cost of living.
2. Working to expand affordable childcare options and push for universal preschool and afterschool programs.
3. Make community college free for all students.

[**You can help make these priorities a reality by chipping in $6 to my campaign**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69629382/426753176/1183499175?refcode=2023-09-12-rx&recurring=0&amount=6&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=042791ea-a951-ee11-9937-00224832e811&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQxNjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMDQyNzkxZWEtYTk1MS1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=2KTYkv5ydDTm5k21Ph7hfg21aCQpPNJE-RROs2fnFl4=)**.** Together, we can end the squeeze of inflation and tackle the high costs of childcare, education, health care, and more. clean_body: Right now, people are choosing between groceries and electricity. | | | | Peter, Across the country and in California's 30th, rising prices have been top of mind for many people. Thankfully, we are seeing action to get costs under control. Last month, President Biden announced the first set of prescription drugs that will be eligible for price negotiations with Medicare under the Inflation Reduction Act. Americans pay more for prescription drugs than any other major economy in the world, with Big Pharma gouging consumers in need of life-saving medicine. But thanks to the IRA, Medicare will be able to negotiate better prices for prescriptions, including drugs that treat diabetes, heart failure, and even certain types of cancer. High prescription drug costs have placed an unnecessary burden on the people who need care the most. Around 3 in 10 Americans have chosen to go without their prescriptions because of high costs , putting their health at risk in the process. The IRA tackles these issues head-on, from capping the price of insulin at $35 to these price negotiations, giving people life-saving medication and much needed relief for their pocketbooks. But this work cannot end here. The Inflation Reduction Act was a great start, but Congress must step up more to help people make ends meet. In Congress, I will push us forward by: 1. Voting for a minimum wage that matches the basic cost of living. 2. Working to expand affordable childcare options and push for universal preschool and afterschool programs. 3. Make community college free for all students. =. Together, we can end the squeeze of inflation and tackle the high costs of childcare, education, health care, and more. Hi friends, earlier this year I reintroduced my bill, the My Body, My Data Act, in the House of Representatives because now more than ever, we need to protect our personal reproductive health data.
This essential piece of legislation would create a new national standard to protect our personal data. The bill addresses the huge gap in privacy laws that we need to fill if we’re going to keep pace with the new and emerging technologies we use every day. By minimizing the personal health data that is collected and retained by apps, cell phones, and search engines, we can prevent our data from being disclosed, misused, or weaponized.
That last piece - the weaponization of our data - is the dystopian-level threat that we’re actually facing right now, so let’s talk about it for a minute. Listen, apps and websites have been collecting and using our personal data for years - we know that, and it can be helpful! - but in this post- Roe v. Wade era, we’re seeing the consequences of this digital surveillance intensify.
Every day - every minute that we’re on our phones and devices - we’re generating data that could be used against us, or against our health care providers and allies. Our locations, search histories, texts, and emails - even our reproductive health data from things like period tracking apps - it’s all collected by companies and websites that can exploit our data and ultimately lead to very real threats to our safety and privacy.
The My Body, My Data Act would address these key issues in several ways:
*
Limit
data
collection.

companies
from
being
able

*

*

*

*
Enforce

We’ll

sure
the
federal

(FTC)
enforces

and

to

the

*
Ensure
accountability.
Should
companies
violate
our
data,
the
bill
includes
a
private
right
of
action
to
allow
individuals
to
hold
them
accountable.
This
part
is
a
big
deal.
As attacks on abortion access increase, my bill will create essential protections for vulnerable individuals. 22 states have already banned or severely restricted abortion - which puts people in those states at increased risk of having their digital footprints weaponized against them.
And this isn’t just a hypothetical - the criminalization of abortion (and miscarriages and stillbirths) is already happening , as prosecutors are exploiting this gap in federal data protections to enforce cruel anti-abortion laws.
We need urgent action to strengthen digital privacy and protect our reproductive health information so that it can’t be used or weaponized against us, and this bill is a great first step to creating this framework and offering some immediate solutions to deter bad actors.
If you agree, please join me by adding your name in support of my bill right now. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/XzSv_TfqL0OUElJPtqwRFw2]
We have a long way to go to ensure our privacy laws address the needs of this century as new technologies continue to advance. I’m proud of this work and this bill, and I hope you know how much I appreciate your help and support in moments like these.
-Sara

body:
Americans are getting caught in the crossfire of the House Freedom Caucus's partisan political games.
[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69629657/426754591/-2027002553?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzNzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2JmZjZhMjYtYWI1MS1lZTExLTk5MzctMDAyMjQ4MzJlODExIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=JPDhmW5TsRc-lLI9X9fQl0ItavyS24C7DRDb56CGLSs=&emci=8ff5f2ec-9c51-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=cbff6a26-ab51-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=3595835)

**The House Freedom Caucus is threatening to jeopardize the security and well-being of countless Americans with a government shutdown, Peter.**

A shutdown would put our economy in jeopardy and would take a major toll on federal workers, including those safeguarding our national parks, civilian shipyard employees, and the Coast Guard.

Normally, shutdowns happen when parties can't agree on spending allocation. But back in June, leaders from both sides of the aisle — and the White House — came to an agreement and passed bipartisan legislation to tackle the debt limit. But despite this bipartisan agreement, the House Freedom Caucus is doing everything it can to try and derail the progress we've made.

Peter, as lawmakers, the commitment we make to the American people must remain unwavering. Whether you've served this nation, work in the federal sector, teach our children, are a senior citizen, or a parent striving to make ends meet, Congress should _always_ have your back. **The threat of a government shutdown is a reminder of what happens when those in power prioritize partisan politics over people.**

As extreme House Republicans threaten Americans with a government shutdown, I'm reaching out to hear about your top priorities — and your concerns — for the weeks, months, and years to come. Your input matters, and I want to ensure that I'm doing all I can to address your concerns effectively in Congress. But despite this bipartisan agreement, the House Freedom Caucus is doing everything it can to try and derail the progress we've made. | Hey — it’s David Hogg, gun safety advocate and co-founder of March For Our Lives.

They are willing to let children be slaughtered at school and watch our planet burn for personal gain.

But badass young people have a habit of being underestimated, from March For Our Lives to the Sunrise Movement to the Movement for Black Lives. And when we demonstrate our collective power, we scare the shit out of Republicans.

**That’s why with an incredible team, we launched Leaders We Deserve** — a grassroots organization dedicated to electing young leaders to Congress, and especially our State Legislatures, across the country to help defeat the far-right’s agenda and advance a progressive vision for the future.

[_**We can’t do this without you by our side. _Content warning: This email mentions suicide._ Friend, Every September, we recognize Suicide Prevention Awareness Month, as suicide is the tenth leading cause of death in the United States and the second leading cause of death among young adults between the ages of 10 and 34. For those living with mental illness, seeking help can still be incredibly difficult given the barriers and stigma associated with mental health, which can often be even more challenging for young adults. That’s why earlier this year, I was proud to co-introduce the _Trauma Support and Mental Health in Schools Reauthorization Act_ — bipartisan legislation to improve access to evidence-based trauma support and mental health care services for students across our country. I understand the mental health struggles communities across our district and country are facing, and that’s why I’m working with my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to raise awareness and pass common-sense legislation to help address the stigma that prevents young adults from seeking help. By passing this legislation, we will increase awareness of mental health issues among students, train school personnel to detect and respond to mental health issues and connect students to the critical services they need. [**Friend, please support my efforts to pass this life-changing bipartisan legislation by signing my petition to call on Congress to pass the Trauma Support and Mental Health in Schools Reauthorization Act and address this public health crisis.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69630561/426758541/1335628165?refcode=AU_NJB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20230912_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMWYyMWQ1Ni1hZjUxLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-LBJJjoKp4KB2nzAyHM-e-06IIaMa4NZ0G-WR0U8sNU=&emci=bea04a5b-ae51-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=a1f21d56-af51-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=13891387) | [ADD MY NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69630562/426758543/1335628165?refcode=AU_NJB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20230912_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjQwNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMWYyMWQ1Ni1hZjUxLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-LBJJjoKp4KB2nzAyHM-e-06IIaMa4NZ0G-WR0U8sNU=&emci=bea04a5b-ae51-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=a1f21d56-af51-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=13891387)

Friend, Every September, we recognize Suicide Prevention Awareness Month, as suicide is the tenth leading cause of death in the United States and the second leading cause of death among young adults between the ages of 10 and 34. For those living with mental illness, seeking help can still be incredibly difficult given the barriers and stigma associated with mental health, which can often be even more challenging for young adults. That’s why earlier this year, I was proud to co-introduce the Trauma Support and Mental Health in Schools Reauthorization Act — bipartisan legislation to improve access to evidence-based trauma support and mental health care services for students across our country. I understand the mental health struggles communities across our district and country are facing, and that’s why I’m working with my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to raise awareness and pass common-sense legislation to help address the stigma that prevents young adults from seeking help. By passing this legislation, we will increase awareness of mental health issues among students, train school personnel to detect and respond to mental health issues and connect students to the critical services they need. | Thank you for all you do. Together, we can fight to ensure our communities have the resources to address and break down the stigma associated with mental illness. — Nikki = Nikki for Congress PO Box 5171 Springfield, IL 62705 United States ** | mailto:info@nikkiforcongress.com | Paid for by Nikki Budzinski for Congress

subject: Your Signature Is Needed: Save innocent gray wolves and grizzly bears from ruthless trophy hunters in honor of the ESA’s 50th Anniversary
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1980565?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | This week, as we celebrate the _**50th Anniversary of the Endangered Species Act**_ (ESA), it is a crucial time to take action on behalf of imperiled species like gray wolves and grizzly bears who are at critical risk of losing their life-saving ESA protections. **[Will you speak up today to defend the Endangered Species Act? Sign our petition>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1980566?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Due to major rollbacks to the ESA in 2016, it remains LEGAL in several states for ruthless trophy hunters to **violently blow up** nursing mama bears and sleeping cubs in their dens with _**dynamite.**_ It’s LEGAL to **brutally massacre** entire packs of gray wolves and wolf pups. And it’s LEGAL to use some of the **most inhumane and horrific killing methods** on these innocent animals -- _**like choking snares, steel leg traps, and even running precious grizzlies and gray wolves over with snowmobiles.**_ Without stronger ESA protections for these vulnerable animals, these two beloved native species could go completely **__EXTINCT__** at the hands of violent trophy hunters who will **viciously slaughter** grizzly bears and gray wolves without mercy. **[Please, Friend, these helpless creatures need you to be their voice. Don’t ignore their desperate cries for help. Sign our petition now to help SAVE innocent gray wolves and grizzly bears!>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1980567?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1980568?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Right now, _**corrupt and extremist lawmakers**_ are working with the hunting lobby and other Big Polluters to roll back the remaining ESA protections for gray wolves and grizzly bears. If it were up to them, trophy hunters all across the country would have a __**LICENSE TO KILL**__ and free reign to **recklessly MURDER** these precious animals without cause or consequence.
Losing these two keystone species wouldn’t just be _**heartbreaking for biodiversity**_ , as both grizzly bears and gray wolves are among the most iconic species representing North American wilderness -- but it would also have **_devastating impacts on our ecosystems_** in which both animals play important roles on our public lands.
_**The situation is dire and urgent, Friend.**_ These defenseless animals are clinging to survival, and they’re counting on us to keep them safe from merciless trophy hunters. In honor of the __**50th Anniversary of the Endangered Species Act**__ , we’re calling on **6,000 environmentalists** to sign our petition by the deadline TOMORROW to help demonstrate strong public pressure. **[Your signature today could determine the fate of imperiled gray wolves and grizzly bears. Can these helpless animals count on you right now to step up and take action before cruel trophy hunters wipe them out? Add your name now before it’s too late>>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1980569?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1980568?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

Friend, Where have you been? If you haven't yet, it's high time you get to meet _**Cameron Hamilton**._ While many see him as the Republican Congressional Candidate for Virginia’s 7th district, to me, he is much more: a dear friend, a stalwart patriot, and a man of unyielding principle. Cameron's journey as a loving husband, dedicated father, and revered Navy SEAL veteran paints a vivid picture of his character. He has always put others before himself, whether that was his team on dangerous deployments or his family during challenging times. _**_I truly believe that Cameron Hamilton is what VA-07 needs_****. **_ However, he is up against tough opposition. That's why I am reaching out personally to urge you, to endorse Cameron Hamilton in his bid for Congress. An endorsement from someone of your stature could significantly bolster his campaign, uniting our party and our district. With Cameron and your support, I believe we can bring about the change we desire. **[Your endorsement could be the catalyst we need. Washington state has record-high home prices, some of the highest gas prices in the country, and a hefty new payroll tax. The affordability crisis we are currently experiencing didn’t “just happen” – it’s the result of policies from the Inslee administration, and a Bob Ferguson administration will be more of the same.

If you want a Governor who will put affordability first, join this campaign. If you want a Governor who understands the urgency of building affordable housing, this is your campaign. Friend, Since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ last summer, Republican legislators banned or more tightly restricted abortion in 22 states, far-right judges on federal courts have tried to limit access to medication abortion, and Republicans in Congress have proposed a nationwide abortion ban. **But we can fight back and win.** **In all 6 states with abortion measures on the ballot over the past year, voters turned out to support abortion rights** —including in my home state of Michigan and in “red” states like Kansas, Kentucky, and Montana. We’re seeing a similar pattern in Ohio right now, and more state-level fights are on the horizon for 2024. Clearly, abortion justice is a winning issue. The majority of people are in agreement that abortion care is healthcare and a human right. | | As you read this, millions of people are barred from voting because they were previously convicted of felonies. An estimated 5.8 million formerly incarcerated people have entered back into a society that denies them a say in issues directly affecting their communities, their families, and their lives. And in nine states — Arizona, Wyoming, Iowa, Connecticut, Virginia, Tennessee, Mississippi, Alabama, and Florida — formerly incarcerated people may be _permanently_ stripped of their freedom to vote. [_**We’re working towards a democracy that includes all of us, and that doesn’t prevent folks from making their voices heard simply because they were incarcerated. Sign your name if you agree that formerly incarcerated people should be able to vote everywhere.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69632626/426765218/-742281645?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20230912_e_felonies_v1s2&ms=bsc_emm_ffa_20230912_e_felonies_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDUzNzNhMS1iNjUxLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1-Mr_qdPOVnLU4DrE53DX8pa5UGiRd1ycaQc6kc817Q=&emci=5ac722f4-b451-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=645373a1-b651-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=1037277) | [SIGN YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69632630/426765222/-742281645?refcode=bsc_emm_ffa_20230912_e_felonies_v1s2&ms=bsc_emm_ffa_20230912_e_felonies_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDUzNzNhMS1iNjUxLWVlMTEtOTkzNy0wMDIyNDgzMmU4MTEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1-Mr_qdPOVnLU4DrE53DX8pa5UGiRd1ycaQc6kc817Q=&emci=5ac722f4-b451-ee11-9937-00224832e811&emdi=645373a1-b651-ee11-9937-00224832e811&ceid=1037277)

In a country with a long and painful history of mass incarceration that disproportionately targets Black Americans, these laws are a clear relic of the Jim Crow Era. They’re designed to further suppress Black voting rights and weaken Black voting power. Despite making up 12 percent of the overall population of the U.S., Black Americans account for 40 percent of the formerly incarcerated people who can’t vote.
At Fair Fight Action, we’re committed to challenging racist voter suppression laws like these and fighting for an inclusive democracy. [_**If you’re with us, sign your name to show that you support restoring voting rights for formerly incarcerated people. They’re designed to further suppress Black voting rights and weaken Black voting power. Despite making up 12 percent of the overall population of the U.S., Black Americans account for 40 percent of the formerly incarcerated people who can’t vote. | Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. I’m a mother, a teacher, a state senator, and the Democratic nominee for the special election in Utah’s 2nd Congressional District. I’m running to fight for public education, to protect our fundamental freedoms, and to put families first — while my MAGA opponent has promised to cut Social Security and pass a national abortion ban.

**This race is our first chance of the 2024 cycle to flip a House seat from red to blue.** The general election just began here, and it’s going to be a sprint to the finish line. Voters go to polls on November 21 – only 70 days from now!

Since I announced my candidacy this summer, I’ve heard a few variations of this question:
“You don’t really expect to win as a _Democrat_ in _Utah,_ right?”
So let me be absolutely clear: **I am in this race to win, and I’ve got a track record of winning tough fights.**

I won a Republican-leaning district on the Utah State Board of Education in 2016. I had never run for office before, but I was determined to make sure my state’s education policy incorporated the views of people who’ve spent years in the classroom.

I saw up close on the Board of Education how the legislature’s extremism and one-party rule held up progress and hurt working Utahns. So in 2018, I ran for State Senate to cut through the theatrics, end the gridlock, and actually _solve_ the problems facing our families. Utah Republicans really wanted to hold this seat; they worked hard to try to undermine me, but our people-powered campaign won out and defeated a sitting incumbent.

I learned first-hand in these early campaigns just how important the voices of everyday people are, and just how powerful they can be. **I won before on the strength of grassroots donations, and I’m aiming to do it again.**

Pundits are ready to write off any Democrat in a federal race in Utah. But I can tell you: folks here are sick and tired of what MAGA Republicans like my opponent have to offer.

They’re ready for a leader who will fight to protect individual healthcare decisions. A leader who will fight to protect our classrooms from government overreach. A leader who will fight to protect our environment and stand up to the corporate interests that are polluting our air and water. A leader who will stand firm on the side of compassion when politicians threaten to cut Social Security and Medicare.

Every day on the campaign trail, I’m making the case to Utahns in the 2nd District why I’m that leader. But I can’t do it alone.

Thank you,

_Kathleen_

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Brazil, Chile, and Colombia
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Highlights from my trip to Latin America.
#
I just returned from an amazing trip with several of my colleagues to Brazil, Chile, and Colombia.
**Our hope was that this visit could help chart a new course for the relationship between the United States and Latin America.** Rather than continuing the old Cold War mentality, we want the two regions to build a relationship of trust and respect — so that we can work on shared challenges like migration, climate change, and threats to democracy.
Here are some highlights from the trip...
**I led the first all Spanish-speaking delegation from the U.S.** , which included Representatives Nydia Velázquez, Greg Casar, Maxwell Frost, and Joaquin Castro. Nearly every meeting our delegation took was conducted in Spanish — even in Brazil, given the amount of diplomacy they engage with in the region most of their representatives speak Spanish as well as Portugues. It makes a _huge_ difference having a U.S. congressional delegation where every member is fluent in a language spoken by the folks we are visiting. Completely changes the dynamic!
**We learned a lot about community organizing.** In Brazil, our delegation met with the Landless Workers Movement and the Homeless Workers Movement. Both groups engage in radical, direct actions like land occupation. At the same time, they are deeply pragmatic movements. They have community kitchens to support their members, and have built markets to sell workers’ goods that finance their operations. It was a good lesson in how idealism and pragmatism can, and should, coexist in our progressive organizing.
**Ahead of our visit to Chile, we helped declassify documents detailing U.S. involvement in the Pinochet coup** ,1 which overthrew Chile’s government in 1973 and was one of the first coup d’etats caught on TV. The U.S., under President Richard Nixon and Henry Kissinger, launched a campaign of economic warfare and covert operations in Chile in order to destabilize the region after the country elected its first socialist president, Salvador Allende. After ousting Allende, the new Pinochet regime — with support from our government — tortured and murdered over 40,000 Chileans, and forced over 200,000 more to flee the country. For years, the U.S. has refused to disclose the extent of its involvement, and while there are still many documents that should be declassified, this was an important first step.
**We met with Colombia’s first leftist President, Gustavo Petro, and discussed his efforts for peace.** The endless stream of disinformation around the globe — including Fox News and the far-right in the U.S. — flattens the perception of Colombia to a hazy picture of violence, narcos, and guerrillas. The reality is that the Colombian people are extremely motivated towards peace, and efforts by Senator Marco Rubio and other Republicans to block ambassadorships — and other normal diplomatic relationships — with Colombia only serves to further destabilize the country.
**We have much to learn from our counterparts in these countries.** My hope is that the trip also demonstrated that the U.S. is more than the right-wing extremism that dominates headlines, and that we are a diverse nation not only in identity, but also in our openness towards the world — and especially Latin America.
Thank you for reading,
Alexandria

body:
#
Friend – no one thought I could win in 2018.

I was up against an 11-term Republican who had been in Congress since I was a teenager. Polls showed me down by double digits.

[That didn't stop me. I worked day and night to connect with Texans and earn their votes. I won that race with 52% of the vote.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/23-allred-split?amount=25?source=em230912-zm-ca-split&refcode2=429_8507_tcSj8w&akid=429%2E8507%2EtcSj8w)

**[DONATE NOW TO HELP ME DEFEAT TED CRUZ →](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/23-allred-split?amount=25?source=em230912-zm-ca-split&refcode2=429_8507_tcSj8w&akid=429%2E8507%2EtcSj8w)**
**Look, I know I'm the underdog again this year.** People have even told me that I can't win this race and should just stay in my safe seat in Congress.

**But we're already better off than we were in 2018:** Polls show me just five points down with 14% of voters undecided.

**And Ted Cruz only won reelection by 2.6% last time.**

So winning will come down to reaching those undecided voters, and that's what I'm doing right now. I'm road tripping across Texas, and I've already met thousands of voters who are as fed up as you and I are with Ted Cruz.

So with folks like you on my team, I know we can win.

**If we can just keep connecting with voters, I know we can win this thing. But I'm counting on your support ahead of my end-of-month deadline to help me keep it up:** [_Please, will you split a donation of $5, $10, whatever you can spare, between my campaign and Zak for Congress to help me fire Ted Cruz and give Texans the senator we deserve? →_](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/23-allred-split?amount=25?source=em230912-zm-ca-split&refcode2=429_8507_tcSj8w&akid=429%2E8507%2EtcSj8w)

# FROM THE DESK OF NEWT GINGRICH
---
| | Dear Peter, **I’m pleased to share with you that The New York Sun is now carrying my exclusive weekly column.**

In it, I'll weigh in on the most pressing matters facing our country – and there are many.

**Under the Biden administration, our nation has lost its way.** Many politicians and major institutions are corrupt. Leading corporations are following their lead.

But it’s the corruption of the media that has me most concerned. In my 70-year career in American politics, I’ve never seen it so bad. For this reason, I’ve chosen The New York Sun as a partner.

It’s a paper that shines like a beacon amid a sea of lies and misinformation. It has done so for nearly 200 years.

**It’s a patriotic paper that lives and breathes American values.** It places our Constitution front and center and has long been among its most valiant defenders.

It remains our nation’s most effective counterweight to The New York Times, which has bizarrely claimed the title of “paper of record” but speaks for so few of our fellow citizens.

Now more than ever, the battle for the future of our nation starts with the restoration of real American journalism, and The New York Sun is devoted to that mission. It truly "shines for all."

But I know what the Sun is up against. All the cards are stacked against us.

To win, we need you to join us. To join The New York Sun is to join the movement to save America.

**Membership starts at just 1 cent per day.**

Just hours before I announced my campaign, Kevin McCarthy removed me from the Intelligence Committee, where I’ve served as Chairman and top Democrat for years. All because I held Trump and MAGA Republicans accountable.

As it turned out, that was just the beginning. Ever since I started running to serve Californians in the Senate, McCarthy, Matt Gaetz, Tucker Carlson, and the entire Fox News machine have attacked me nearly every day.

Just last month, McCarthy claimed that a Republican could win this Senate race in California and also said they needed to make sure I didn’t win.

**It’s clear that McCarthy and his right-wing allies are going to do everything they can to prevent me from becoming California’s next Senator. That’s why it’s so important we hit tonight's fundraising goal and send a powerful message: I’m not going anywhere.

| | |
---

---
|
# The Real Reason They’re
Trying to Keep Me Off the Stage
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Friends, The RNC has a choice to make. As I wrote in my latest [Daily Caller column](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=52aa33105b&e=0be619cbaa), they’re on the spot. Your overwhelming response to our message of American Restoration has put them in a bind. **Will the RNC encourage a REAL debate or discourage it? Will Republican insiders support free speech or oppose it? Will they represent an entrenched establishment or the entirety of the Republican Party?** If they choose to try and keep me off that debate stage, they’ll be sending a message to you, the hardworking people who demand a government that puts America First: **You’re not welcome.** [**It’s time we sent them a message. But I need your support. Donate what you can TODAY, so we can send a clear message to the political establishment: we will not be ignored.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=0f51140fcc&e=0be619cbaa) To qualify for the first debate last month, we cleared each bar they set up for us. We received contributions from more than 40,000 voters in 37 states. We hit all the key polling benchmarks, and we signed the RNC’s loyalty pledge. Despite that, the RNC came up with half-baked reasons to ignore our polling performance and even refused to accept our offer to supplement it with additional polls as proof. Make no mistake: they fear our campaign, so they’re shutting us out. They want all talk, and all the American people want is action. The RNC knows I am an independent conservative who won’t answer to them. I am the only candidate willing to discuss the epidemic of fatherlessness, the damage inflicted by Soros’s district attorneys, and the myth of “systemic racism.” **I will not let you be ignored.** That’s why my campaign has launched a half a million dollar [national advertising campaign](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=3b0fca5941&e=0be619cbaa). That’s why we filed a complaint with the Federal Election Commission to hold accountable the RINOs who have refused to play by the rules. And that’s why we sent a letter to the RNC demanding [fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity.](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=244bc1eccc&e=0be619cbaa) [I am doing everything I can, but I need your support. Please give whatever amount you can to help us get the word out. Each donation of **ANY SIZE** goes a long way to helping us spread our message of American Restoration to every corner of the country. As our support grows, it will become more and more difficult for the RNC to justify keeping me off that debate stage. This election is too important for candidates to avoid addressing the solutions to our many problems.](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=938270f701&e=0be619cbaa) As patriots, we cannot allow the establishment to continue America’s decline. Our decline is only inevitable if we trust in the wrong leaders, and I’ve had enough of doing that in a blue state. That’s why I’m fighting back against the Washington establishment harder than any other candidate who will be on the debate stage this month. This fight isn’t just about me. Ours is a fight for the democracy, freedom, and equality of opportunity that have come to define American prosperity over the centuries. We are fighting for America’s soul. But if we win, we can start the long hard work of bringing about a New American Golden Age. [I hope I can count on your support.](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=9720a2a0b6&e=0be619cbaa) Thank you,
**Larry Elder**
GOP Candidate for President
